qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Flux?
qh: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स (Magnetic Flux) का 'SI मात्रक' क्या है?
e: Weber is the unit of magnetic flux, whereas Tesla is for magnetic induction. / वेबर चुंबकीय फ्लक्स की इकाई है, जबकि टेस्ला चुंबकीय प्रेरण के लिए है।

qe: What is the 'CGS unit' of Magnetic Flux?
qh: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स की 'CGS इकाई' क्या है?
e: $1 Weber = 10^8 Maxwell$. / 1 वेबर = 10^8 मैक्सवेल।

qe: What is the value of 'Earth's Magnetic Field' approx at the surface?
qh: पृथ्वी की सतह पर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' का अनुमानित मान क्या है?
e: Very weak compared to laboratory magnets. / प्रयोगशाला के चुंबकों की तुलना में बहुत कमजोर।

qe: Which material is used for 'Core' of high-frequency transformers?
qh: उच्च आवृत्ति वाले ट्रांसफार्मर के 'कोर' के लिए किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Ferrites have high resistivity which reduces eddy current losses at high frequencies. / फेराइट्स भंवर धाराओं को कम करते हैं।

qe: What is 'Self Induction' of a coil of 100 turns if flux is 5 Weber for 2A current?
qh: 100 फेरों वाली कुंडली का 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' क्या होगा यदि 2A करंट पर फ्लक्स 5 वेबर है?
e: $L = \Phi / I = 5/2 = 2.5 H$. (Note: for single turn equivalent). / सूत्र L = फ्लक्स/करंट।

qe: What happens to 'Permeability' when a substance is heated?
qh: गर्म करने पर पदार्थ की 'पारगम्यता' का क्या होता है?
e: Thermal agitation disrupts magnetic alignment. / तापीय विक्षोभ चुंबकीय संरेखण को बाधित करता है।

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of magnetic field due to a circular current loop?
qh: वृत्ताकार करंट लूप के कारण चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की दिशा कौन सा 'नियम' देता है?
o: Right-hand Palm Rule | दाएं हाथ की हथेली का नियम
e: Fingers curl in current direction, thumb gives field direction at center. / अंगूठा केंद्र पर क्षेत्र की दिशा बताता है।

qe: What is 'Neutral Point' in a magnetic field?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में 'उदासीन बिंदु' (Neutral Point) क्या है?
o: Resultant magnetic field is zero | परिणामी चुंबकीय क्षेत्र शून्य है
e: Where external field cancels Earth's horizontal component. / जहाँ बाहरी क्षेत्र पृथ्वी के क्षैतिज घटक को काट देता है।

qe: Which device uses 'Mutual Induction'?
qh: कौन सा उपकरण 'अन्योन्य प्रेरण' (Mutual Induction) का उपयोग करता है?
e: Transfer of energy between two coils via changing flux. / बदलते फ्लक्स के माध्यम से दो कुंडलियों के बीच ऊर्जा का स्थानांतरण।

qe: The 'Magnetic Field' at a point on the axis of a circular coil is proportional to:
qh: वृत्ताकार कुंडली के अक्ष पर किसी बिंदु पर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' किसके समानुपाती होता है?
e: For points far from the center, field follows inverse cube law. / दूर स्थित बिंदुओं के लिए व्युत्क्रम घन नियम।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' for 'Superconductors'?
qh: 'अतिचालकों' (Superconductors) के लिए 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' क्या है?
e: Perfect diamagnetism implies $\chi = -1$. / पूर्ण प्रति-चुंबकत्व का अर्थ $\chi = -1$ है।

qe: Which instrument uses a 'Suspended Magnet' to measure Earth's field?
qh: पृथ्वी के क्षेत्र को मापने के लिए कौन सा उपकरण 'लटके हुए चुंबक' का उपयोग करता है?
e: Measures time period of oscillations. / दोलनों के आवर्तकाल को मापता है।

qe: What is the angle of dip at '45 degree' latitude approx?
qh: '45 डिग्री' अक्षांश पर नति कोण लगभग क्या होता है?
e: Varies with magnetic latitude ($\tan\theta = 2\tan\phi$). / यह चुंबकीय अक्षांश के साथ बदलता है।

qe: The 'Magnetic Induction' (B) is related to 'H' and 'I' by:
qh: 'B', 'H' और 'I' में क्या संबंध है?
e: Total induction is the sum of external force and material response. / कुल प्रेरण बाहरी बल और पदार्थ की प्रतिक्रिया का योग है।

qe: What is the 'Flux' unit Weber in terms of Volt-second?
qh: वोल्ट-सेकंड के संदर्भ में 'फ्लक्स' की इकाई वेबर क्या है?
e: $e = -d\Phi/dt \implies \Phi = e \cdot t$. / विद्युत चुम्बकीय प्रेरण से।

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of 'Steel' compared to 'Soft Iron'?
qh: 'नरम लोहे' की तुलना में 'स्टील' की 'निग्राहिता' क्या है?
e: Steel is harder to demagnetize, making it good for permanent magnets. / स्टील को विचुंबकित करना कठिन है।

qe: Which 'Substance' shows magnetic properties due to 'Paired Electrons'?
qh: 'युग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों' के कारण कौन सा 'पदार्थ' चुंबकीय गुण दिखाता है (अक्सर कमजोरी से)?
e: Paired electrons' magnetic moments cancel, leaving only diamagnetic effect. / युग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों के आघूर्ण कट जाते हैं।

qe: What is 'Angle of Declination' used for in navigation?
qh: नेविगेशन में 'दिकपात कोण' का उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
o: Correcting compass to find True North | सही उत्तर दिशा खोजने हेतु
e: Compass points to magnetic north, declination helps find geographic north. / कंपास चुंबकीय उत्तर बताता है, दिकपात भौगोलिक उत्तर खोजने में मदद करता है।

qe: What happens if a magnet is heated beyond its 'Curie Point'?
qh: यदि चुंबक को उसके 'क्यूरी बिंदु' से आगे गर्म किया जाए तो क्या होगा?
o: Becomes paramagnetic | अनुचुंबकीय हो जाता है
e: Orderly magnetic domains are destroyed by heat. / तापीय ऊर्जा से व्यवस्थित चुंबकीय डोमेन नष्ट हो जाते हैं।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Shielding' based on?
qh: 'चुंबकीय परिरक्षण' किस पर आधारित है?
o: High permeability of materials | उच्च पारगम्यता
e: Magnetic field lines prefer to pass through high permeability paths. / क्षेत्र रेखाएं उच्च पारगम्यता वाले रास्तों से गुजरना पसंद करती हैं।

qe: A 'Dip Circle' is set in 'Magnetic Meridian'. The needle points at 90°. Where is it?
qh: 'नति वृत्त' चुंबकीय मध्याह्न में सेट है। सुई 90° दिखाती है। यह कहाँ है?
e: Vertical field exists only at the poles. / लंबवत क्षेत्र केवल ध्रुवों पर होता है।

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a unit area perpendicular to the magnetic field?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के लंबवत इकाई क्षेत्र से गुजरने वाला 'फ्लक्स' क्या है?
e: Also called Flux Density. / इसे फ्लक्स घनत्व भी कहते हैं।

qe: What is 'Intensity of Magnetization' for a vacuum?
qh: निर्वात के लिए 'चुंबकन की तीव्रता' क्या है?
e: Vacuum has no atoms to magnetize. / निर्वात में चुंबकित करने के लिए कोई परमाणु नहीं होते।

qe: Which 'Principle' allows an 'Electric Crane' to pick up heavy iron scrap?
qh: 'इलेक्ट्रिक क्रेन' किस 'सिद्धांत' से भारी लोहे का कबाड़ उठाती है?
e: Temporary magnetism produced by large currents. / बड़े करंट द्वारा उत्पन्न अस्थायी चुंबकत्व।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Permeability' ratio?
qh: 'चुंबकीय पारगम्यता' किसका अनुपात है?
e: Magnetic induction divided by magnetizing force. / चुंबकीय प्रेरण और चुंबकन बल का अनुपात।

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Susceptibility' ($\chi$) of a Diamagnetic substance?
qh: ek prati-chumbakiya padarth ki 'chumbakiya pravritti' ($\chi$) kya hoti hai?
o: Small and Negative | chhoti aur rinatmak
e: It is negative because these materials develop magnetization opposite to the applied field. / ye rinatmak hoti hai kyunki ye padarth bahari kshetra ke viprit chumbakit hote hain.

qe: Which material is 'Repelled' weakly by a strong magnetic field?
qh: kaun sa padarth ek shaktishali chumbakiya kshetra dwara kamzori se pratikarshit hota hai?
e: Water, Bismuth, and Copper are examples of diamagnetic substances. / pani, bismuth aur tamba prati-chumbakiya padarthon ke udaharan hain.

qe: What is the relation between 'Magnetic Permeability' ($\mu$) and Susceptibility ($\chi$)?
qh: 'chumbakiya pargamyata' ($\mu$) aur 'pravritti' ($\chi$) ke beech kya sambandh hai?
e: Relative permeability is the sum of unity and susceptibility. / sapeksh pargamyata, ek aur pravritti ka yog hoti hai.

qe: Which phenomenon is used in 'Magnetic Braking' in high-speed trains?
qh: uchchh gati wali trainon mein 'chumbakiya braking' mein kis ghatna ka upyog hota hai?
e: Eddy currents create a magnetic drag that slows down the train without friction. / bhanwar dharayen ek chumbakiya khinchav paida karti hain jo bina gharshan train ko dheema karta hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Iron Core' of a transformer during operation?
qh: transformer ke 'iron core' ka kaam ke dauran kya hota hai?
o: Heats up due to hysteresis and eddy currents | hysteresis aur eddy currents ke karan garam hota hai
e: Energy losses in the core are dissipated as heat. / core mein hone wala oorja ka nuksan ushma ke roop mein nikalta hai.

qe: A transformer works with:
qh: transformer kiske saath kaam karta hai?
e: Transformers require a changing magnetic flux, which only AC provides. / transformer ko badalte chumbakiya flux ki zarurat hoti hai, jo sirf AC deta hai.

qe: What is the 'Efficiency' of an ideal transformer?
qh: ek adarsh transformer ki 'dakshta' kya hoti hai?
e: An ideal transformer has no energy losses (heat, flux leakage, etc.). / ek adarsh transformer mein oorja ka koi nuksan nahi hota.

qe: Which rule is used to find the 'Polarity' of an induced EMF?
qh: prerit EMF ki 'dhruvta' (polarity) janne ke liye kis niyam ka upyog hota hai?
o: Lenz's Law | lenz ka niyam (Lenz's Law)
e: Lenz's law determines the direction of current to oppose the change in flux. / lenz ka niyam flux badlav ke virodh ki disha batata hai.

qe: What is 'Curie Temperature' for Nickel approx?
qh: nickel ke liye 'curie tapman' lagbhag kya hai?
e: Lower than Iron (770°C) but significantly high. / lohe (770°C) se kam par kaafi uchchh.

qe: What is the unit of 'Magnetic Field Strength' (H) in CGS?
qh: CGS mein 'chumbakiya kshetra teevrata' (H) ki ikai kya hai?
e: Oersted is the unit for H in the CGS system. / CGS system mein H ke liye oersted ikai hai.

qe: Which material is used in 'Magnetic Tapes' for recording?
qh: recording ke liye 'chumbakiya tape' mein kis padarth ka upyog hota hai?
e: Uses ferromagnetic particles to store information via magnetization. / chumbakan ke madyam se jaankari store karne ke liye upyog hota hai.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' ($L$) related to 'Magnetic Flux' ($\Phi$) and Current ($I$)?
qh: 'sw-prerakatva' (L), 'flux' ($\Phi$) aur 'current' (I) se kaise sambandhit hai?
e: Flux is directly proportional to the current through the inductor. / flux prerak ke madhyam se behne wale current ke samanupati hota hai.

qe: What is the angle of dip at the 'Magnetic Equator'?
qh: 'chumbakiya bhumadhya rekha' par nati kon kya hota hai?
e: The magnetic field is perfectly horizontal at the equator. / bhumadhya rekha par chumbakiya kshetra bilkul kshaitij hota hai.

qe: What is the function of 'Lamination' in a transformer core?
qh: transformer core mein 'lamination' ka kya kaam hai?
o: Reduce eddy current loss | eddy current nuksan ko kam karna
e: Thin sheets insulated from each other prevent large circulating currents. / ek dusre se alag patli sheets badi dharayon ko rokati hain.

qe: Which 'Law' is used to define the unit of current 'Ampere' based on magnetic force?
qh: chumbakiya bal ke aadhar par current ki ikai 'ampere' ko paribhashit karne ke liye kaun sa 'niyam' upyog hota hai?
o: Ampere's Force Law | ampere ka bal niyam
e: Defined by the force between two parallel wires carrying current. / do samantar dharavahi taron ke beech bal dwara paribhashit.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of a Paramagnetic substance?
qh: ek anu-chumbakiya padarth ki 'chumbakiya pravritti' kya hoti hai?
o: Small and Positive | chhoti aur dhanatmak
e: They are weakly attracted in the direction of the magnetic field. / ye chumbakiya kshetra ki disha mein kamzori se akarshit hote hain.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Permeability?
qh: chumbakiya pargamyata ki 'SI ikai' kya hai?
e: Also expressed as Henry per meter (H/m). / ise Henry prati meter bhi kaha jata hai.

qe: Which device 'Converts' electrical energy into mechanical energy?
qh: kaun sa upkaran vidyut oorja ko yaantrik oorja mein 'badalta' hai?
e: Works on the principle of force on a current-carrying coil in a magnetic field. / chumbakiya kshetra mein dharavahi coil par lagne wale bal par kaam karta hai.

qe: What is 'Mutual Inductance' unit?
qh: 'anyonya prerakatva' (Mutual Inductance) ki ikai kya hai?
e: Same unit as self-inductance. / sw-prerakatva ke saman ikai.

qe: The core of a 'Moving Coil Galvanometer' is usually made of:
qh: 'moving coil galvanometer' ka core aamtour par kisse bana hota hai?
e: Soft iron makes the magnetic field radial and increases its strength. / narm loha chumbakiya kshetra ko trijya (radial) aur mazboot banata hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Induced EMF' if the speed of a magnet moving towards a coil is increased?
qh: yadi coil ki aur badhte chumbak ki gati badha di jaye, to 'prerit EMF' ka kya hoga?
e: EMF is proportional to the rate of change of flux ($d\Phi/dt$). / EMF flux badlav ki dar ke samanupati hota hai.

qe: Which material is used to make 'Permanent Magnets' for headphones?
qh: headphones ke liye 'sthayi chumbak' banane mein kis padarth ka upyog hota hai?
e: Neodymium magnets are very strong permanent magnets. / neodymium chumbak bahut shaktishali sthayi chumbak hote hain.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Hysteresis' loop width related to?
qh: 'chumbakiya hysteresis' loop ki chaudai kisse sambandhit hai?
e: Larger coercivity means a wider loop. / adhik nigrahita ka matlab hai chauda loop.

qe: What is 'Energy Loss' in a transformer core through heat called?
qh: transformer core mein ushma dwara hone wala 'oorja nuksan' kya kehlata hai?
o: Iron loss / Core loss | iron loss / core loss
e: Includes both hysteresis and eddy current losses. / isme hysteresis aur eddy current dono nuksan shamil hain.

qe: Which 'Rule' is used to find the direction of magnetic field produced by a solenoid?
qh: perinalika (solenoid) dwara paida chumbakiya kshetra ki disha janne ke liye kaun sa 'niyam' upyog hota hai?
o: Right-hand Palm Rule | dayein hath ki hatheli ka niyam
e: Fingers curl in current direction, thumb gives North pole direction. / ungliyan current ki disha mein, angutha uttar dhruv ki disha batata hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Induction' unit in CGS?
qh: CGS mein 'chumbakiya preran' ki ikai kya hai?
e: $1 Tesla = 10^4 Gauss$.

qe: Which material has 'Large and Positive' susceptibility?
qh: kis padarth ki pravritti 'badi aur dhanatmak' hoti hai?
e: They get strongly magnetized in the direction of field. / ye kshetra ki disha mein mazbooti se chumbakit hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Path' of a charge if it enters a magnetic field at an angle of 45°?
qh: yadi koi avesh 45° ke kon par chumbakiya kshetra mein pravesh kare, to uska 'path' kya hoga?
e: Components of velocity create both circular and linear motion. / veg ke ghatak vrittakar aur rekhika gati dono paida karte hain.

qe: What is the 'Flux' unit Weber equal to in terms of Tesla?
qh: Tesla ke sandarbh mein 'flux' ikai Weber kiske barabar hai?
e: Flux = Magnetic Field $\times$ Area. / flux = chumbakiya kshetra $\times$ kshetraphal.

qe: Which device works on the principle of 'Self Induction'?
qh: kaun sa upkaran 'sw-preran' ke siddhant par kaam karta hai?
e: Used in fluorescent lights to limit AC current with minimum energy loss. / oorja ki kam hani ke saath AC current ko simit karne ke liye upyog hota hai.

qe: What is 'Retentivity' of Steel compared to Soft Iron?
qh: narm lohe ki tulna mein steel ki 'dharanshilta' (Retentivity) kya hai?
e: Steel has lower retentivity but higher coercivity than soft iron. / steel ki dharanshilta kam par nigrahita narm lohe se zyada hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of Steel compared to Soft Iron?
qh: narm lohe ki tulna mein steel ki 'nigrahita' (Coercivity) kya hai?
e: Steel is much harder to demagnetize. / steel ko vichumbakit karna bahut kathin hai.

qe: Which 'Force' is responsible for the working of an Electric Bell?
qh: 'vidyut ghanti' ke kaam karne ke liye kaun sa 'bal' zimmedar hai?
o: Magnetic force from electromagnet | vidyut chumbak ka chumbakiya bal
e: Electromagnet attracts the iron armature to strike the gong. / vidyut chumbak iron armature ko akarshit karta hai.

qe: What is 'Aclinic Line' also known as?
qh: 'aclinic line' ko aur kya kaha jata hai?
e: Line joining points with zero angle of dip. / shunya nati kon wale binduon ko jodne wali rekha.

qe: What is 'Isogonic Line'?
qh: 'isogonic line' kya hai?
e: Line joining points with equal magnetic declination. / saman chumbakiya dikpat wale binduon ko jodne wali rekha.

qe: What is 'Agonic Line'?
qh: 'agonic line' kya hai?
e: Isogonic line with zero declination. / shunya dikpat wali isogonic rekha.

qe: The speed of light in a medium is $v = 1/\sqrt{\mu\epsilon}$. In vacuum, it is:
qh: madhyam mein prakash ki chaal $v = 1/\sqrt{\mu\epsilon}$ hai. nirvat mein ye hai:
e: Fundamental constant derived from Maxwell's equations. / maxwell ke samikaranon se vyutpann maulik niyatank.

qe: What happens to the 'Self Inductance' of a coil if a 'Soft Iron Core' is inserted?
qh: yadi coil mein 'narm loha core' daala jaye, to 'sw-prerakatva' ka kya hoga?
e: $L = \mu_r \mu_0 n^2 A l$. High $\mu_r$ increases inductance significantly. / uchchh sapeksh pargamyata prerakatva ko kaafi badha deti hai.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Field' at the center of a circular current loop of radius $R$?
qh: $R$ trijya wale vrittakar dharavahi loop ke kendra par 'chumbakiya kshetra' kya hai?
e: Maximum field is at the center of the loop. / loop ke kendra par kshetra adhiktam hota hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Potential' unit?
qh: 'chumbakiya vibhav' ki ikai kya hai?
e: Analogous to electric potential (Joule/Coulomb). / vidyut vibhav ke saman.

qe: Which material is used for 'Magnetic Shielding' of sensitive instruments?
qh: sanvedansheel upkaranon ki 'chumbakiya parirakshan' ke liye kya upyog hota hai?
e: Mu-metal is an alloy with very high permeability. / mu-metal bahut uchchh pargamyata wala ek mishra-dhatu hai.

qe: What is 'Flux Leakage' in a transformer?
qh: transformer mein 'flux leakage' kya hai?
o: Primary flux not linking secondary | prathmik flux ka dwitiyak se na judna
e: Reduces the efficiency of the transformer. / transformer ki dakshta ko kam karta hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of intensity of magnetization ($I$)?
qh: chumbakan ki teevrata (I) ki 'SI ikai' kya hai?
e: Magnetic moment per unit volume. / prati ikai aaytan chumbakiya aghurn.

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loss' dependent on?
qh: 'hysteresis nuksan' kis par nirbhar karta hai?
o: Area of B-H loop | B-H loop ka kshetraphal
Volume of material | padarth ka aaytan
Frequency of AC | AC ki aavritti
e: Loss = $\eta \cdot A \cdot V \cdot f$. / sabhi karakon par nirbhar.

qe: Which device uses 'Electromagnetic Induction' to detect metal in security checks?
qh: security check mein metal detect karne ke liye kaun sa upkaran 'vidyut chumbakiya preran' ka upyog karta hai?
e: Metal disrupts the induced magnetic field, triggering an alarm. / metal prerit chumbakiya kshetra ko badhit karta hai.

qe: What is the value of 'Permeability of Free Space' ($\mu_0$)?
qh: 'mukt sthan ki pargamyata' ($\mu_0$) ka maan kya hai?
e: Fundamental constant of nature. / prakriti ka maulik niyatank.

qe: What is 'Isoclinic Line'?
qh: 'isoclinic line' kya hai?
o: Same angle of dip | saman nati kon (dip)
e: Line joining points with equal magnetic dip. / saman chumbakiya nati kon wale binduon ko jodne wali rekha.

qe: Which 'Substance' has the highest susceptibility among these?
qh: inme se kis 'padarth' ki pravritti sabse adhik hai?
e: Ferromagnetic materials have very large $\chi$. / louh-chumbakiya padarthon mein $\chi$ bahut bada hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Flux' through a surface area $A$ perpendicular to field $B$?
qh: kshetra $B$ ke lumbvat satah kshetraphal $A$ se guzarne wala 'chumbakiya flux' kya hai?
e: Flux $\Phi = B \cdot A \cos\theta$. For $\theta=0^\circ$, $\Phi = BA$. / adhiktam flux lumbvat satah par hota hai.

qe: What is the full form of 'MRI' in medical science?
qh: चिकित्सा विज्ञान में 'MRI' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Magnetic Resonance Imaging | Magnetic Resonance Imaging
e: Uses strong magnetic fields and radio waves to create detailed images of organs. / अंगों की विस्तृत छवियां बनाने के लिए मजबूत चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का उपयोग करता है।

qe: Which 'Nuclei' are primarily used in MRI scans?
qh: MRI स्कैन में मुख्य रूप से किन 'नाभिकों' का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: MRI detects the magnetic behavior of hydrogen atoms in body water/fat. / यह शरीर के पानी/वसा में हाइड्रोजन परमाणुओं के चुंबकीय व्यवहार का पता लगाता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Levitation' (Maglev) used in?
qh: 'चुंबकीय उत्तोलन' (Maglev) का उपयोग किसमें होता है?
o: High-speed trains | उच्च गति वाली ट्रेनें
e: Magnetic poles repel each other to lift and propel the train above tracks. / चुंबकीय ध्रुव ट्रेन को पटरियों के ऊपर उठाने और चलाने के लिए एक-दूसरे को पीछे धकेलते हैं।

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Dipole Moment?
qh: चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: $M = I \times A$. Unit is $A \cdot m^2$. / चुंबकीय आघूर्ण की इकाई एम्पीयर-मीटर$^2$ है।

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a circular coil of $N$ turns proportional to?
qh: $N$ फेरों वाली एक वृत्ताकार कुंडली का 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' किसके समानुपाती होता है?
e: Inductance increases with the square of the number of turns. / प्रेरकत्व फेरों की संख्या के वर्ग के साथ बढ़ता है।

qe: What is 'Lenz's Law' based on?
qh: 'लेंज का नियम' किस पर आधारित है?
e: Ensures that energy is conserved during electromagnetic induction. / सुनिश्चित करता है कि प्रेरण के दौरान ऊर्जा सुरक्षित रहे।

qe: What is the value of 'Relative Permeability' ($\mu_r$) for air?
qh: हवा के लिए 'सापेक्ष पारगम्यता' ($\mu_r$) का मान क्या है?
e: Permeability of air is very close to that of a vacuum. / हवा की पारगम्यता निर्वात के बहुत करीब होती है।

qe: Which rule is used to determine the 'Direction of Force' on a moving charge?
qh: गतिमान आवेश पर 'बल की दिशा' निर्धारित करने के लिए किस नियम का उपयोग होता है?
o: Fleming's Left-hand Rule | फ्लेमिंग के बाएं हाथ का नियम
e: Thumb=Force, Forefinger=Field, Middle finger=Velocity. / अंगूठा बल की दिशा को दर्शाता है।

qe: What happens to 'Earth's Magnetic Field' intensity as we move from Equator to Poles?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा से ध्रुवों की ओर जाने पर पृथ्वी के 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' की तीव्रता का क्या होता है?
e: The total field intensity is higher at the poles than at the equator. / ध्रुवों पर कुल क्षेत्र की तीव्रता भूमध्य रेखा से अधिक होती है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' ($\chi$) for a Ferromagnetic material?
qh: लौह-चुंबकीय पदार्थ के लिए 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' ($\chi$) क्या होती है?
e: They are very easily and strongly magnetized. / वे बहुत आसानी से और मजबूती से चुंबकित होते हैं।

qe: Which device uses 'Eddy Currents' to provide 'Damping' in pointers?
qh: पॉइंटर्स में 'अवमंदन' (Damping) प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सा उपकरण 'भंवर धाराओं' का उपयोग करता है?
e: Electromagnetic damping stops the needle from vibrating. / विद्युत चुंबकीय अवमंदन सुई को हिलने से रोकता है।

qe: What is 'Hysteresis' loss zero for?
qh: 'हिस्टेरेसिस' हानि किसके लिए शून्य होती है?
e: Only ferromagnetic materials show hysteresis. / केवल लौह-चुंबकीय पदार्थ ही हिस्टेरेसिस दिखाते हैं।

qe: What is 'Curie's Law' constant related to?
qh: 'क्यूरी के नियम' का नियतांक किससे संबंधित है?
e: States that magnetization is proportional to $1/T$. / बताता है कि चुंबकन $1/T$ के समानुपाती है।

qe: Which material is used in 'Solenoid' core to increase magnetic field?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र बढ़ाने के लिए 'परिनालिका' कोर में किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Soft iron has high permeability, concentrating the flux. / नरम लोहे की पारगम्यता उच्च होती है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Flux' per unit area called?
qh: प्रति इकाई क्षेत्रफल 'चुंबकीय फ्लक्स' क्या कहलाता है?
e: Magnetic induction $B = \Phi/A$. / चुंबकीय प्रेरण फ्लक्स प्रति इकाई क्षेत्रफल है।

qe: What is 'Step-up Transformer' function?
qh: 'स्टेप-अप ट्रांसफार्मर' का कार्य क्या है?
e: Increases AC voltage by having more turns in the secondary coil. / द्वितीयक कुंडली में अधिक फेरे रखकर वोल्टेज बढ़ाता है।

qe: What is 'Step-down Transformer' function?
qh: 'स्टेप-डाउन ट्रांसफार्मर' का कार्य क्या है?
e: Reduces high voltage AC to lower voltage for household use. / घरों में उपयोग के लिए उच्च वोल्टेज AC को कम करता है।

qe: What is 'Mutual Induction' dependent on?
qh: 'अन्योन्य प्रेरण' किस पर निर्भर करता है?
o: Distance between coils | कुंडलियों के बीच की दूरी
Number of turns | फेरों की संख्या
e: Affected by physical arrangement and material core. / भौतिक व्यवस्था और कोर सामग्री से प्रभावित।

qe: Which 'Part' of Earth's magnetic field is ZERO at the Equator?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा पर पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का कौन सा 'भाग' शून्य होता है?
e: The field is perfectly horizontal at the equator. / भूमध्य रेखा पर क्षेत्र पूरी तरह क्षैतिज होता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Declination' at a place?
qh: किसी स्थान पर 'चुंबकीय दिकपात' क्या है?
o: Angle between geographic and magnetic North | भौगोलिक और चुंबकीय उत्तर के बीच का कोण
e: Tells how much a compass deviates from True North. / बताता है कि कंपास सही उत्तर से कितना विचलित है।

qe: What is 'Weber' unit for?
qh: 'वेबर' किसकी इकाई है?
e: Standard SI unit for magnetic flux ($\Phi$). / चुंबकीय फ्लक्स के लिए मानक इकाई।

qe: What is the 'Path' of a charge entering a magnetic field at an acute angle ($<90^\circ$)?
qh: न्यून कोण पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करने वाले आवेश का 'पथ' क्या होगा?
e: Velocity component along field gives linear motion, perpendicular gives circular. / क्षेत्र के साथ वेग का घटक रेखीय और लंबवत घटक वृत्ताकार गति देता है।

qe: Which material has 'Negative' susceptibility?
qh: किस सामग्री की प्रवृत्ति 'ऋणात्मक' होती है?
e: Diamagnetic materials like Copper, Bismuth, and Water. / तांबा, बिस्मथ और पानी जैसे प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थ।

qe: What is 'Retentivity' higher in?
qh: 'धारणशीलता' किसमें अधिक होती है?
e: Soft iron retains more induction, but is easier to demagnetize. / नरम लोहा अधिक प्रेरण रखता है, लेकिन विचुंबकित करना आसान है।

qe: What is 'Coercivity' higher in?
qh: 'निग्राहिता' किसमें अधिक होती है?
e: Steel needs a stronger reverse field to demagnetize. / स्टील को विचुंबकित करने के लिए मजबूत विपरीत क्षेत्र चाहिए।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Potential' analogous to?
qh: 'चुंबकीय विभव' किसके समान है?
e: Defined as work done to bring a unit North pole from infinity. / इकाई उत्तरी ध्रुव को अनंत से लाने में किया गया कार्य।

qe: What is 'Tesla-meter/Ampere' the unit of?
qh: 'टेस्ला-मीटर/एम्पीयर' किसकी इकाई है?
e: SI unit of magnetic permeability. / चुंबकीय पारगम्यता की SI इकाई।

qe: Which 'Law' is used to calculate the magnetic field of a long straight wire?
qh: लंबे सीधे तार के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की गणना के लिए किस 'नियम' का उपयोग होता है?
o: Ampere's Circuital Law | एम्पीयर का परिपथीय नियम
e: Simplifies calculation for symmetric current distributions. / सममित करंट वितरण के लिए गणना को आसान बनाता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Field' at the 'Center' of a square loop carrying current?
qh: करंट ले जाने वाले वर्गाकार लूप के 'केंद्र' में 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' क्या होता है?
e: Sum of fields from 4 segments is calculated at center. / केंद्र में 4 खंडों के क्षेत्रों का योग होता है।

qe: Which part of Earth acts like a 'Giant Magnet'?
qh: पृथ्वी का कौन सा भाग एक 'विशाल चुंबक' की तरह कार्य करता है?
e: Earth behaves like a bar magnet tilted at 11.5 degrees. / पृथ्वी 11.5 डिग्री पर झुके हुए बार चुंबक की तरह व्यवहार करती है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Flux' unit Maxwell equal to in terms of Weber?
qh: वेबर के संदर्भ में चुंबकीय फ्लक्स इकाई 'मैक्सवेल' किसके बराबर है?
e: $1 Maxwell = 10^{-8} Weber$. / मैक्सवेल छोटी CGS इकाई है।

qe: What is 'Shunt' resistance in an ammeter?
qh: एम्पीयरमीटर में 'शंट' प्रतिरोध क्या होता है?
e: Low resistance in parallel to bypass large current. / बड़े करंट को बायपास करने हेतु कम समानांतर प्रतिरोध।

qe: What is 'Multiplier' in a voltmeter?
qh: वोल्टमीटर में 'मल्टीप्लायर' (Multiplier) क्या है?
e: High resistance in series to limit current through coil. / कुंडली से करंट सीमित करने हेतु उच्च श्रेणीक्रम प्रतिरोध।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Intensity' (H) independent of?
qh: 'चुंबकीय तीव्रता' (H) किससे स्वतंत्र है?
e: H depends only on current and geometry, not the core material. / H केवल करंट और ज्यामिति पर निर्भर करती है।

qe: Which 'Substance' has susceptibility $\chi$ around $10^3$?
qh: किस 'पदार्थ' की प्रवृत्ति $\chi$ लगभग $10^3$ होती है?
e: Ferromagnetic materials have very high susceptibility. / लौह-चुंबकीय पदार्थों की प्रवृत्ति बहुत उच्च होती है।

qe: What is 'Eddy Current' heating used for in industry?
qh: उद्योगों में 'भंवर धारा' तापन का उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
e: Used to melt metals by producing heat through eddy currents. / भंवर धाराओं के माध्यम से ऊष्मा पैदा कर धातुओं को पिघलाने हेतु।

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a plane area $A$ parallel to magnetic field $B$?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $B$ के समानांतर समतल क्षेत्र $A$ के माध्यम से 'फ्लक्स' क्या है?
e: Angle $\theta = 90^\circ$ between field and normal to area, $\cos 90^\circ = 0$. / क्षेत्र और क्षेत्रफल के लंबवत के बीच 90 डिग्री का कोण।

qe: Which 'Part' of Earth's magnetic field is maximum at Equator?
qh: भूमध्य रेखा पर पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का कौन सा 'भाग' अधिकतम होता है?
e: Since field is parallel to Earth's surface at Equator. / क्योंकि भूमध्य रेखा पर क्षेत्र सतह के समानांतर होता है।

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a coil also known as 'Inertia of Electricity'?
qh: कुंडली के 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' को 'विद्युत की जड़ता' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: It opposes change in current | यह करंट में बदलाव का विरोध करता है
e: Analogous to mass in mechanics which opposes change in motion. / यांत्रिकी में द्रव्यमान के समान जो गति में बदलाव का विरोध करता है।

qe: Which material is used for 'Electromagnet' cores?
qh: 'विद्युत चुंबक' के कोर के लिए किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Requires low retentivity and high permeability. / कम धारणशीलता और उच्च पारगम्यता की आवश्यकता होती है।

qe: What is 'Relative Permeability' ($\mu_r$) for a 'Superconductor'?
qh: 'अतिचालक' के लिए 'सापेक्ष पारगम्यता' ($\mu_r$) क्या है?
e: Perfect diamagnetism results in $\mu_r = 0$. / पूर्ण प्रति-चुंबकत्व का परिणाम $\mu_r = 0$ होता है।

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Permeability of free space?
qh: मुक्त स्थान की चुंबकीय पारगम्यता की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Unit of $\mu_0$ is $H/m$. / $\mu_0$ की इकाई $H/m$ है।

qe: What is 'Hall Effect'?
qh: 'हॉल प्रभाव' (Hall Effect) क्या है?
o: Voltage across a conductor in magnetic field | चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में चालक पर उत्पन्न वोल्टेज
e: Used to determine the sign and density of charge carriers. / आवेश वाहकों के चिह्न और घनत्व को निर्धारित करने हेतु प्रयुक्त।

qe: What is 'Tesla' in terms of Weber and Meter?
qh: वेबर और मीटर के संदर्भ में 'टेस्ला' क्या है?
e: Flux density unit relation. / फ्लक्स घनत्व इकाई संबंध।

qe: Which material is 'Bismuth' categorized as?
qh: 'बिस्मथ' को किस श्रेणी में रखा गया है?
e: One of the strongest diamagnetic materials. / सबसे मजबूत प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थों में से एक।

qe: What is the 'Flux' linkage unit?
qh: 'फ्लक्स लिंकेज' की इकाई क्या है?
e: Product of number of turns and flux through each turn. / फेरों की संख्या और प्रत्येक फेरे से फ्लक्स का गुणनफल।

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of Alnico compared to Steel?
qh: स्टील की तुलना में एलनिको की 'निग्राहिता' क्या है?
e: Alnico is excellent for making very strong permanent magnets. / एलनिको मजबूत स्थायी चुंबक बनाने के लिए बेहतरीन है।

qe: What is the unit of 'Magnetic Pole Strength'?
qh: 'चुंबकीय ध्रुव शक्ति' की इकाई क्या है?
e: Derived from the force formula between poles. / ध्रुवों के बीच बल के सूत्र से व्युत्पन्न।

qe: A 'Tangent Galvanometer' works on the principle of:
qh: 'टेंजेंट गैल्वेनोमीटर' किस सिद्धांत पर कार्य करता है?
e: $B = B_h \tan\theta$. / यह पृथ्वी के क्षैतिज क्षेत्र और कुंडली के क्षेत्र के संतुलन पर आधारित है।

qe: What is the 'Dynamo Effect' related to Earth's magnetism?
qh: Prithvi ke chumbaktva se juda 'Dynamo Effect' kya hai?
o: Convection currents in outer core | Baahri core mein sanvahan dharayen
e: Movement of molten iron in the outer core generates electric currents and magnetic fields. / Baahri core mein pighle lohe ki gati chumbakiya kshetra paida karti hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' ($\chi$) for a vacuum?
qh: Nirvat ke liye 'chumbakiya pravritti' ($\chi$) kya hai?
e: Vacuum cannot be magnetized, so its susceptibility is zero. / Nirvat ko chumbakit nahi kiya ja sakta, isliye pravritti shunya hai.

qe: Which scientist predicted the existence of 'Electromagnetic Waves'?
qh: 'Vidyut chumbakiya tarango' ki bhavishyavani kis vaigyanik ne ki thi?
o: James Clerk Maxwell | James Clerk Maxwell
e: Maxwell predicted them mathematically, while Hertz later proved them experimentally. / Maxwell ne ganitiya roop se bhavishyavani ki thi.

qe: What is the relation between 'Induced EMF' ($e$) and 'Flux' ($\Phi$)?
qh: 'Prerit EMF' (e) aur 'Flux' ($\Phi$) ke beech kya sambandh hai?
e: According to Faraday's Law, EMF is the negative rate of change of flux. / Faraday ke niyam ke anusar, EMF flux badlav ki dar hai.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Flux' through a closed surface (Gauss's Law for Magnetism)?
qh: Ek band satah se guzarne wala 'chumbakiya flux' kya hota hai?
e: Total magnetic flux through any closed surface is always zero because monopoles don't exist. / Band satah se kul flux hamesha shunya hota hai.

qe: Which material shows 'Small and Positive' magnetic susceptibility?
qh: Kaun sa padarth 'chhoti aur dhanatmak' chumbakiya pravritti dikhata hai?
e: Paramagnetic materials like Aluminium have small positive $\chi$. / Anu-chumbakiya padarthon ki pravritti chhoti aur dhanatmak hoti hai.

qe: What is the angle of dip at a place where $B_H = B_V$?
qh: Us sthan par nati kon kya hoga jahan kshaitij aur lumbvat ghatak barabar hain?
e: $\tan\theta = B_V/B_H$. If $B_V=B_H$, then $\tan\theta = 1$, so $\theta=45^\circ$.

qe: What is the speed of 'Electromagnetic Waves' in vacuum?
qh: Nirvat mein 'vidyut chumbakiya tarango' ki chaal kya hai?
e: They travel at the speed of light. / Ye prakash ki chaal se chalti hain.

qe: Which 'Part' of a transformer is made of 'Soft Iron' laminated sheets?
qh: Transformer ka kaun sa 'bhag' narm lohe ki laminated sheets se bana hota hai?
e: Laminated core reduces eddy current losses. / Laminated core eddy current nuksan ko kam karta hai.

qe: What is the unit of 'Magnetic Field Intensity' (H)?
qh: 'Chumbakiya kshetra teevrata' (H) ki ikai kya hai?
e: H is the magnetizing force applied. / H lagaya gaya chumbakan bal hai.

qe: What is 'Curie-Weiss Law' used for?
qh: 'Curie-Weiss niyam' ka upyog kisliye hota hai?
o: Ferromagnets above Curie point | Curie bindu ke upar louh-chumbak
e: Describes susceptibility in the paramagnetic phase of a ferromagnet. / Ye louh-chumbak ke anu-chumbakiya phase ki pravritti batata hai.

qe: Which rule is used to find the direction of 'Magnetic Force' on a moving proton?
qh: Gatiman proton par 'chumbakiya bal' ki disha janne ke liye kaun sa niyam upyog hota hai?
o: Fleming's Left-hand rule | Fleming ka baayein hath ka niyam
e: For positive charges, use the left-hand rule. / Dhanatmak avesh ke liye baayein hath ka niyam upyog karein.

qe: What happens to the 'Magnetic Moment' if a magnet is heated?
qh: Chumbak ko garam karne par uske 'chumbakiya aghurn' ka kya hota hai?
e: Heat increases thermal agitation, disrupting magnetic alignment. / Garmi chumbakiya sanrekhan ko bigad deti hai.

qe: What is 'Bohr Magneton' related to?
qh: 'Bohr Magneton' kisse sambandhit hai?
o: Magnetic moment of an electron | Electron ka chumbakiya aghurn
e: It is the natural unit for expressing magnetic moment of an atom. / Ye parmanu ke chumbakiya aghurn ko vyakt karne ki prakritik ikai hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Mutual Inductance?
qh: 'Anyonya prerakatva' ki SI ikai kya hai?
e: Both self and mutual inductance have the same unit, Henry. / Dono prerakatva ki ikai Henry hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Step-up Transformer' turns ratio ($N_s/N_p$)?
qh: Step-up transformer ka phero ka anupat ($N_s/N_p$) kya hota hai?
e: Secondary has more turns to increase voltage. / Voltage badhane ke liye secondary mein zyada phere hote hain.

qe: What is 'Step-down Transformer' turns ratio ($N_s/N_p$)?
qh: Step-down transformer ka phero ka anupat ($N_s/N_p$) kya hota hai?
e: Secondary has fewer turns to decrease voltage. / Voltage ghatane ke liye secondary mein kam phere hote hain.

qe: Which property of a wave 'Intensity' depends on?
qh: Tarang ki 'Teevrata' kis gun par nirbhar karti hai?
e: Intensity is proportional to the square of both amplitude and frequency. / Teevrata aayam aur aavritti dono ke varg ke samanupati hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Eddy Current' loss in a transformer core minimized by?
qh: Transformer core mein 'Eddy current' nuksan kaise kam kiya jata hai?
e: Using thin sheets insulated from each other. / Ek dusre se alag patli sheets ka upyog karke.

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a unit area called?
qh: Ikai kshetraphal se guzarne wala 'Flux' kya kehlata hai?
e: Also known as flux density. / Ise flux ghnatv bhi kehte hain.

qe: Which material has 'Large and Positive' susceptibility?
qh: Kaun sa padarth 'badi aur dhanatmak' pravritti dikhata hai?
e: Ferromagnetic materials are strongly magnetized. / Louh-chumbakiya padarth mazbooti se chumbakit hote hain.

qe: What is the 'Angle of Dip' at Earth's magnetic equator?
qh: Prithvi ki chumbakiya bhumadhya rekha par 'nati kon' kya hai?
e: The field is horizontal at the equator. / Bhumadhya rekha par kshetra kshaitij hota hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Meridian' plane?
qh: 'Chumbakiya madhyahan' tal kya hai?
o: Vertical plane through magnetic axis | Chumbakiya aksh se guzarne wala lumbvat tal
e: The plane where a magnetic needle stays. / Wo tal jahan chumbakiya sui rukti hai.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a solenoid proportional to length ($l$)?
qh: Solenoid ka 'Sw-prerakatva' lambai (l) ke kaise sambandhit hai?
e: $L = \mu_0 N^2 A / l$. It is inversely proportional to length. / Ye lambai ke vyutkramanupati hota hai.

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of magnetic field for a current loop?
qh: Current loop ke liye chumbakiya kshetra ki disha kaun sa 'niyam' deta hai?
o: Right-hand Palm rule | Dayein hath ki hatheli ka niyam
e: Thumb gives field direction at center if fingers curl with current. / Angutha kendra par kshetra ki disha batata hai.

qe: What is the 'Path' of a charge if velocity is perpendicular to the field?
qh: Yadi veg kshetra ke lumbvat ho toh avesh ka 'path' kya hoga?
e: Magnetic force provides centripetal force. / Chumbakiya bal kendrabhimukh bal pradan karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Relative Permeability' of a Diamagnet?
qh: Diamagnet ki 'sapeksh pargamyata' kya hai?
e: Slightly less than one. / Ek se thodi kam.

qe: What is 'Aclinic Line' joining?
qh: 'Aclinic Line' kise jodti hai?
o: Zero Dip points | Shunya nati kon wale bindu
e: Also called the Magnetic Equator. / Ise chumbakiya bhumadhya rekha bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is the speed of EM waves in a medium of $\mu$ and $\epsilon$?
qh: $\mu$ aur $\epsilon$ wale madhyam mein EM tarango ki chaal kya hai?
e: Speed is determined by the medium's properties. / Chaal madhyam ke guno par nirbhar karti hai.

qe: What is the 'Coercivity' of Steel compared to Soft Iron?
qh: Narm lohe ki tulna mein steel ki 'Nigrahita' kya hai?
e: Steel is much harder to demagnetize. / Steel ko vichumbakit karna bahut kathin hai.

qe: What is 'Mutual Inductance' between two coils?
qh: Do coils ke beech 'Anyonya prerakatva' kya hai?
o: EMF induced in one due to change in other | Ek mein badlav se dusri mein prerit EMF
e: Basis for transformer operation. / Transformer ke kaam karne ka aadhar.

qe: What is 'Tesla-meter/Ampere' the unit of?
qh: 'Tesla-meter/Ampere' kiski ikai hai?
e: Standard unit for $\mu$. / $\mu$ ki manak ikai.

qe: What happens if you 'Cut' a bar magnet into 4 pieces?
qh: Yadi bar chumbak ko 4 tukdo mein 'kaate' toh kya hoga?
o: 4 separate magnets are formed | 4 alag chumbak ban jayenge
e: Each piece will have its own N and S pole. / Har tukde ka apna N aur S dhruv hoga.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Declination' measured with?
qh: 'Chumbakiya dikpat' kisse maapa jata hai?
o: Compass and Map | Compass aur Map
e: Angle between True North and Magnetic North. / Satya uttar aur chumbakiya uttar ke beech ka kon.

qe: Which device uses 'Electromagnetic Induction' to measure heart activity?
qh: Kaun sa upkaran hriday ki gatividhi maapne ke liye 'Vidyut chumbakiya preran' ka upyog karta hai?
e: Detects magnetic fields produced by electrical activity of the heart. / Hriday ki vidyut gatividhi se paida chumbakiya kshetra ko maapta hai.

qe: What is 'Permeability' of a Superconductor below $T_c$?
qh: $T_c$ ke niche 'Superconductor' ki 'pargamyata' kya hoti hai?
e: Expels all magnetic lines (Meissner Effect). / Saari chumbakiya rekhao ko bahar nikal deta hai.

qe: What is 'Self Induction' unit?
qh: 'Sw-prerakatva' ki ikai kya hai?
e: Inductance is measured in Henry (H). / Prerakatva Henry mein maapa jata hai.

qe: What is 'Flux' unit in CGS?
qh: CGS mein 'Flux' ki ikai kya hai?
e: $1 Wb = 10^8 Maxwell$.

qe: Which 'Parameter' changes when a wave enters a medium?
qh: Jab tarang madhyam mein pravesh karti hai toh kaun sa 'Parameter' badalta hai?
o: Speed and Wavelength | Chaal aur Tarangdaidhy
e: Frequency remains constant as it depends on source. / Aavritti niyat rehti hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Intensity' (H) for a solenoid?
qh: Solenoid ke liye 'Chumbakiya teevrata' (H) kya hai?
e: Does not depend on the core material. / Core material par nirbhar nahi karti.

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loop' area related to?
qh: 'Hysteresis Loop' ka kshetraphal kisse sambandhit hai?
o: Energy loss per cycle | Prati chakra oorja ki hani
e: Larger area means higher energy loss as heat. / Bada kshetraphal matlab zyada oorja hani.

qe: What is the 'Flux' linkage for 100 turns if each has 0.1 Wb?
qh: 100 phero ke liye flux linkage kya hoga yadi har phere mein 0.1 Wb hai?
e: $100 \times 0.1 = 10$ Weber-turns.

qe: What is 'Retentivity' of Soft Iron?
qh: Narm lohe ki 'Dharanshilta' (Retentivity) kya hai?
e: It can be easily magnetized to a high level. / Ise aasani se uchh star tak chumbakit kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of Soft Iron?
qh: Narm lohe ki 'Nigrahita' (Coercivity) kya hai?
e: It loses magnetism easily once the field is removed. / Kshetra hat-te hi ye chumbaktva kho deta hai.

qe: What is 'Tesla' in terms of Gauss?
qh: Gauss ke sandarbh mein 'Tesla' kya hai?
e: $1 Tesla = 10,000 Gauss$.

qe: What is 'Agonic Line'?
qh: 'Agonic Line' kya hai?
e: Joins places with zero magnetic declination. / Shunya chumbakiya dikpat wale sthano ko jodti hai.

qe: What is 'Isogonic Line'?
qh: 'Isogonic Line' kya hai?
e: Joins places with equal magnetic declination. / Saman chumbakiya dikpat wale sthano ko jodti hai.

qe: What is the unit of 'Magnetic Dipole Moment' per unit volume?
qh: Prati ikai aaytan 'Chumbakiya dvidhruv aghurn' ki ikai kya hai?
e: Also called intensity of magnetization (M). / Ise chumbakan ki teevrata bhi kehte hain.

qe: On which principle does an 'AC Generator' work?
qh: 'AC Generator' kis siddhant par karya karta hai?
e: Converts mechanical energy into electrical energy using Faraday's Law. / Faraday ke niyam ka upyog karke yaantrik oorja ko vidyut oorja mein badalta hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' ($\chi$) of a Diamagnetic liquid in a U-tube?
qh: U-tube mein ek prati-chumbakiya drav ki 'chumbakiya pravritti' kaisi hoti hai?
o: Liquid level falls | drav ka star girta hai
e: Diamagnetic substances are repelled by magnetic fields, so the level in the tube falls. / prati-chumbakiya padarth pratikarshit hote hain, isliye star gir jata hai.

qe: Which factor 'Does Not' affect the 'Self Inductance' of a coil?
qh: kaun sa karak ek coil ke 'sw-prerakatva' ko prabhavit 'nahi' karta?
o: Current flowing through it | isse behne wala current
e: Inductance is a geometric property and doesn't depend on the current magnitude. / prerakatva ek jyamitiya gun hai aur current par nirbhar nahi karta.

qe: What is the 'Efficiency' of a transformer formula?
qh: transformer ki 'dakshta' ka sutra kya hai?
o: Output Power / Input Power | output shakti / input shakti
e: Ratio of useful power delivered to the power consumed. / upyogi shakti aur khapt shakti ka anupat.

qe: What is the unit of 'Magnetic Field Gradient'?
qh: 'chumbakiya kshetra pravanta' ki ikai kya hai?
e: Change in magnetic field per unit distance. / prati ikai doori par chumbakiya kshetra mein badlav.

qe: Which material has 'Large and Negative' susceptibility?
qh: kis padarth ki pravritti 'badi aur rinatmak' hoti hai?
e: Superconductors show perfect diamagnetism ($\chi = -1$). / ati-chalak purn prati-chumbaktva dikhate hain.

qe: What is 'Curie Temperature' of 'Cobalt' approx?
qh: 'cobalt' ka 'curie tapman' lagbhag kya hai?
e: Highest Curie temperature among common ferromagnetic metals. / samanya louh-chumbakiya dhaton mein adhiktam curie tapman.

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loss' in 'Hard Steel' compared to 'Soft Iron'?
qh: 'narm lohe' ki tulna mein 'kathor steel' mein 'hysteresis hani' kya hoti hai?
e: Hard steel has a much larger B-H loop area. / kathor steel ka B-H loop kshetraphal bahut bada hota hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of a Paramagnetic gas proportional to?
qh: ek anu-chumbakiya gas ki 'pravritti' kiske samanupati hoti hai?
e: According to Curie's Law. / curie ke niyam ke anusar.

qe: What is 'Energy' stored in an inductor of inductance 'L' and current 'I'?
qh: 'L' prerakatva aur 'I' current wale prerak mein sanchit 'oorja' kya hai?
e: Stored in the form of a magnetic field. / chumbakiya kshetra ke roop mein sanchit.

qe: In a 'Step-up Transformer', which quantity 'Decreases'?
qh: ek 'step-up transformer' mein kaun si rashi 'ghat-ti' hai?
e: To keep power constant ($V \times I$), current must decrease if voltage increases. / shakti ko niyat rakhne ke liye current ghat jata hai.

qe: What is 'Eddy Current' loss dependent on 'Frequency' ($f$)?
qh: 'eddy current' hani 'aavritti' ($f$) par kaise nirbhar karti hai?
e: Losses increase rapidly with frequency. / aavritti ke saath nuksan tezi se badhta hai.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a straight wire of infinite length?
qh: ek anant lambai ke seedhe tar ka 'sw-prerakatva' kya hota hai?
e: Theoretically infinite for an infinitely long wire. / saiddhantik roop se anant.

qe: Which device uses 'Magnetic Force' to separate iron from junk?
qh: kachre se lohe ko alag karne ke liye kaun sa upkaran 'chumbakiya bal' ka upyog karta hai?
e: Uses powerful electromagnets. / shaktishali vidyut chumbakon ka upyog karta hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Susceptibility?
qh: 'chumbakiya pravritti' ki 'SI ikai' kya hai?
e: It is a ratio, so it has no units. / yah ek anupat hai, isliye iska koi matrak nahi hota.

qe: What is 'Isogonic Line' on a map?
qh: manchitra par 'isogonic rekha' kya hai?
o: Points of equal declination | saman dikpat wale bindu
e: Joins places having the same magnetic declination. / saman chumbakiya dikpat wale sthanon ko jodti hai.

qe: Which rule helps find the direction of force on a current-carrying wire in a field?
qh: kshetra mein dharavahi tar par lagne wale bal ki disha kaun sa niyam batata hai?
o: Fleming's Left-hand rule | Fleming ka baayein hath ka niyam
e: Thumb = Force, Forefinger = Field, Middle = Current. / angutha = bal, tarjani = kshetra, madhyama = dhara.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Induction' ($B$) at a point 'r' from a long wire carrying current 'I'?
qh: 'I' current wale lambe tar se 'r' doori par 'chumbakiya preran' ($B$) kya hai?
e: Follows inverse relation with distance. / doori ke saath vyutkramanupati sambandh.

qe: What happens to the 'Speed' of a charged particle in a magnetic field?
qh: ek chumbakiya kshetra mein ek आवेशित कण की 'chaal' (speed) ka kya hota hai?
e: Magnetic force is always perpendicular to velocity, so it only changes direction, not speed. / chumbakiya bal veg ke lumbvat hota hai, isliye sirf disha badalti hai.

qe: Which material is used for 'Magnetic recording' in hard drives?
qh: hard drive mein 'chumbakiya recording' ke liye kya upyog hota hai?
e: Needs high coercivity to keep data stable. / data ko sthir rakhne ke liye uchchh nigrahita chahiye.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a coil of 50 turns if flux is 10 Wb for 5A current?
qh: 50 phero wali coil ka 'sw-prerakatva' kya hai yadi 5A current par flux 10 Wb hai?
e: $L = 10 / 5 = 2$ H. (Flux per unit current). / prati ikai current flux.

qe: What is 'Copper Loss' in a transformer?
qh: transformer mein 'copper hani' kya hai?
o: Heat in windings due to resistance | pratirodh ke karan winding mein ushma
e: Caused by $I^2R$ heating in the coils. / coil mein $I^2R$ taapan ke karan.

qe: What is 'Mutual Induction' between two perpendicular coils?
qh: do lumbvat (perpendicular) coils ke beech 'anyonya preran' kya hota hai?
e: No flux linkage between perpendicular coils. / lumbvat coils ke beech koi flux linkage nahi hota.

qe: What is 'Tesla' equivalent to in terms of 'N, A, m'?
qh: 'N, A, m' ke sandarbh mein 'Tesla' kiske barabar hai?
e: From $F = I L B \sin\theta$, so $B = F/IL$. / $F = ILB$ sutra se.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' for a Vacuum?
qh: nirvat ke liye 'chumbakiya pravritti' kya hai?
e: Vacuum cannot be magnetized. / nirvat ko chumbakit nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Which material is used for 'Pole pieces' of a magnet in a galvanometer?
qh: galvanometer mein chumbak ke 'pole pieces' ke liye kya upyog hota hai?
e: To make the magnetic field radial and strong. / chumbakiya kshetra ko trijya aur mazboot banane ke liye.

qe: What is 'Agonic Line'?
qh: 'agonic rekha' kya hai?
o: Line of zero declination | shunya dikpat wali rekha
e: Joins places where magnetic north and true north are the same. / un sthanon ko jodti hai jahan chumbakiya aur satya uttar ek hi hain.

qe: What is the 'Flux' linkage unit?
qh: 'flux linkage' ki ikai kya hai?
e: Total flux through all turns of a coil. / coil ke sabhi phero se guzarne wala kul flux.

qe: Which 'Law' relates the total magnetic flux through a closed surface to zero?
qh: kaun sa niyam band satah se kul chumbakiya flux ko shunya ke barabar batata hai?
o: Gauss's Law for Magnetism | magnetism ke liye Gauss ka niyam
e: Indicates that magnetic monopoles do not exist. / batata hai ki chumbakiya ekal dhruv nahi hote.

qe: What is 'Retentivity' of Steel?
qh: steel ki 'dharanshilta' (Retentivity) narm lohe ki tulna mein kya hai?
e: Soft iron has higher retentivity but lower coercivity than steel. / narm lohe ki dharanshilta zyada par nigrahita kam hoti hai.

qe: Which 'Force' is used in 'Maglev' trains to lift them?
qh: 'maglev' trainon ko uthane ke liye kis 'bal' ka upyog hota hai?
e: Opposing magnetic poles lift the train off the track. / viprit chumbakiya dhruv train ko track se upar utha dete hain.

qe: What is 'Relative Permeability' ($\mu_r$) for a Diamagnetic substance?
qh: ek prati-chumbakiya padarth ke liye 'sapeksh pargamyata' ($\mu_r$) kya hai?
e: They resist magnetic flux, making relative permeability less than 1. / ye chumbakiya flux ka virodh karte hain.

qe: What is 'Aclinic Line' joining?
qh: 'aclinic rekha' kise jodti hai?
o: Zero dip points | shunya nati kon wale bindu
e: It represents the magnetic equator. / yah chumbakiya bhumadhya rekha ko darshati hai.

qe: What is the speed of EM waves in vacuum formula?
qh: nirvat mein EM tarango ki chaal ka sutra kya hai?
e: Relates vacuum permeability and permittivity to the speed of light. / nirvat pargamyata aur paravaidhyutank ko prakash ki chaal se jodta hai.

qe: Which 'Rule' is used to find the direction of magnetic field for a straight wire?
qh: seedhe tar ke liye chumbakiya kshetra ki disha janne ke liye kaun sa 'niyam' upyog hota hai?
o: Right-hand thumb rule | dayein hath ke anguthe ka niyam
e: Thumb = Current, Fingers = Magnetic field lines. / angutha = current, ungliyan = chumbakiya kshetra.

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loop' area representing?
qh: 'hysteresis loop' ka kshetraphal kya darshata hai?
o: Energy loss per cycle | prati chakra oorja hani
e: Heat generated due to repeated magnetization. / baar-baar chumbakan ke karan paida ushma.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' unit 'Henry' equivalent to?
qh: 'henry' kiske barabar hai?
e: From $\Phi = LI$. / $\Phi = LI$ sutra se.

qe: Which material is used for 'Permanent Magnets' like Alnico?
qh: alnico jaise 'sthayi chumbak' ke liye kya gun zaruri hai?
o: High retentivity and high coercivity | uchchh dharanshilta aur uchchh nigrahita
e: Ensures the magnet remains strong and hard to demagnetize. / chumbak ko mazboot aur vichumbakit karne mein kathin banata hai.

qe: What is the 'Flux' through 100 turns if each turn has 0.2 Weber?
qh: 100 phero mein flux kya hoga yadi har phere mein 0.2 Weber hai?
e: $100 \times 0.2 = 20$. Total flux linkage. / kul flux linkage.

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of Soft Iron?
qh: narm lohe ki 'nigrahita' (Coercivity) kya hoti hai?
e: Makes it easy to magnetize and demagnetize in AC circuits. / AC circuits mein ise chumbakit aur vichumbakit karna aasan banata hai.

qe: Which part of ear is 'Pinna'?
qh: kaan ka kaun sa bhag 'pinna' hai?
e: Collects sound waves. / dhwani tarango ko ikatha karta hai.

qe: What is 'Tesla' in terms of Gauss?
qh: Gauss ke sandarbh mein 'Tesla' kya hai?
e: $1 Tesla = 10,000 Gauss$.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Potential' unit?
qh: 'chumbakiya vibhav' ki ikai kya hai?
e: Analogous to electric potential. / vidyut vibhav ke saman.

qe: Which 'Substance' has susceptibility $\chi < 0$?
qh: kis 'padarth' ki pravritti $\chi < 0$ hoti hai?
e: Diamagnetic materials have small negative susceptibility. / prati-chumbakiya padarthon ki pravritti chhoti aur rinatmak hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a unit area perpendicular to the field?
qh: kshetra ke lumbvat ikai kshetraphal se guzarne wala 'flux' kya hai?
e: Also called magnetic flux density. / ise chumbakiya flux ghnatv bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is 'Intensity of Magnetization' for a vacuum?
qh: nirvat ke liye 'chumbakan ki teevrata' kya hai?
e: Vacuum has no material to magnetize. / nirvat mein chumbakit hone ke liye koi padarth nahi hota.

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of magnetic field for a solenoid?
qh: perinalika ke liye chumbakiya kshetra ki disha kaun sa 'niyam' deta hai?
o: Right-hand Palm rule | dayein hath ki hatheli ka niyam
e: Fingers curl with current, thumb points to North pole. / ungliyan current ke saath, angutha uttar dhruv ki taraf.

qe: What is 'Bio-magnetism'?
qh: 'बायो-मैग्नेटिज्म' क्या है?
o: Magnetism in living organisms | जीवित जीवों में चुंबकत्व
e: Magnetic fields produced by living organisms like humans and birds. / मनुष्यों और पक्षियों जैसे जीवित जीवों द्वारा उत्पन्न चुंबकीय क्षेत्र।

qe: Which 'Organ' in the human body produces the strongest magnetic field?
qh: मानव शरीर का कौन सा 'अंग' सबसे मजबूत चुंबकीय क्षेत्र उत्पन्न करता है?
e: The heart produces a magnetic field about 100 times stronger than the brain. / हृदय मस्तिष्क की तुलना में लगभग 100 गुना अधिक मजबूत चुंबकीय क्षेत्र बनाता है।

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Moment' of an electron due to its orbital motion called?
qh: इलेक्ट्रॉन की कक्षीय गति के कारण उसके 'चुंबकीय आघूर्ण' को क्या कहते हैं?
o: Orbital magnetic moment | कक्षीय चुंबकीय आघूर्ण
e: Arises from the circulation of electron around the nucleus. / नाभिक के चारों ओर इलेक्ट्रॉन के घूमने से उत्पन्न होता है।

qe: What is the value of 'Bohr Magneton' ($\mu_B$) approx?
qh: 'बोहर मैग्नेटन' ($\mu_B$) का अनुमानित मान क्या है?
e: Fundamental unit for the magnetic moment of an atom. / परमाणु के चुंबकीय आघूर्ण की मौलिक इकाई।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Anisotropy'?
qh: 'चुंबकीय एनिसोट्रॉपी' क्या है?
o: Dependence of magnetic properties on direction | दिशा पर चुंबकीय गुणों की निर्भरता
e: Material is easier to magnetize in certain directions than others. / कुछ दिशाओं में चुंबकित करना दूसरों की तुलना में आसान होता है।

qe: The 'Lorentz Force' is used in which instrument to separate isotopes?
qh: आइसोटोप को अलग करने के लिए किस उपकरण में 'लोरेंट्ज़ बल' का उपयोग होता है?
e: Bends the paths of ions based on their mass-to-charge ratio. / आयनों के द्रव्यमान और आवेश के अनुपात के आधार पर उनके पथ को मोड़ता है।

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Field' at the center of a semi-circular current carrying wire?
qh: अर्ध-वृत्ताकार धारावाही तार के केंद्र में 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' क्या होता है?
e: It is exactly half of the field at the center of a full circle. / यह पूरे वृत्त के केंद्र के क्षेत्र का ठीक आधा होता है।

qe: What is 'Curie Temperature' of 'Gadolinium' approx?
qh: 'गैडोलीनियम' का 'क्यूरी तापमान' लगभग क्या है?
e: It is ferromagnetic below room temperature. / यह कमरे के तापमान से नीचे लौह-चुंबकीय होता है।

qe: Which material is used in 'Permanent Magnet' DC motors?
qh: 'स्थायी चुंबक' DC मोटर्स में किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Requires high coercivity to resist demagnetization during use. / उपयोग के दौरान विचुंबकन को रोकने के लिए उच्च निग्राहिता की आवश्यकता होती है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Viscosity'?
qh: 'चुंबकीय श्यानता' (Magnetic Viscosity) क्या है?
o: Time delay in magnetization change | चुंबकन परिवर्तन में समय की देरी
e: Delay between application of field and final magnetization. / क्षेत्र लगाने और अंतिम चुंबकन के बीच का विलंब।

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a coil of 'N' turns related to its area 'A'?
qh: 'N' फेरों वाली कुंडली का 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' उसके क्षेत्रफल 'A' से कैसे संबंधित है?
e: Inductance is directly proportional to the cross-sectional area. / प्रेरकत्व अनुप्रस्थ काट के क्षेत्रफल के सीधे समानुपाती होता है।

qe: What happens to the 'Magnetic Field' inside a superconductor?
qh: एक अतिचालक (Superconductor) के भीतर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' का क्या होता है?
o: Becomes Zero | शून्य हो जाता है
e: Expulsion of magnetic field is called Meissner Effect. / चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का बाहर निकलना मीस्नर प्रभाव कहलाता है।

qe: What is the unit of 'Gyromagnetic Ratio'?
qh: 'गाइरोमैग्नेटिक अनुपात' की इकाई क्या है?
e: Ratio of magnetic moment to angular momentum. / चुंबकीय आघूर्ण और कोणीय संवेग का अनुपात।

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Susceptibility?
qh: 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: It is a ratio, so it has no unit. / यह एक अनुपात है, इसलिए इसका कोई मात्रक नहीं है।

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of eddy currents?
qh: भंवर धाराओं की दिशा कौन सा 'नियम' देता है?
e: Induced currents always oppose the change in magnetic flux. / प्रेरित धाराएं हमेशा चुंबकीय फ्लक्स में बदलाव का विरोध करती हैं।

qe: What is 'Barkhausen Effect'?
qh: 'बरखौसेन प्रभाव' (Barkhausen Effect) क्या है?
o: Step-wise / Jerky magnetization | चरणबद्ध / झटकेदार चुंबकन
e: Evidence for the existence of magnetic domains. / चुंबकीय डोमेन के अस्तित्व का प्रमाण।

qe: What is 'Earth's Magnetic Dip' at 90° latitude (Poles)?
qh: 90° अक्षांश (ध्रुवों) पर पृथ्वी की 'चुंबकीय नति' क्या है?
e: Compass needle stands vertically at the magnetic poles. / चुंबकीय ध्रुवों पर कंपास की सुई लंबवत खड़ी हो जाती है।

qe: What is the 'Flux' linkage for 50 turns if flux is 0.5 Wb per turn?
qh: 50 फेरों के लिए फ्लक्स लिंकेज क्या होगा यदि फ्लक्स 0.5 वेबर प्रति फेरा है?
e: $50 \times 0.5 = 25$ Weber-turns.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Permeability' of water approx?
qh: पानी की 'चुंबकीय पारगम्यता' लगभग क्या है?
e: Water is a diamagnetic substance. / पानी एक प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थ है।

qe: What is 'Remanence' in a B-H loop?
qh: B-H लूप में 'अवशेष चुंबकत्व' (Remanence) क्या है?
o: Value of B when H is max
Value of B when H is Zero | H शून्य होने पर B का मान
e: Residual magnetism left in the material. / पदार्थ में बचा हुआ अवशिष्ट चुंबकत्व।

qe: What is 'Ampere's Circuital Law' integral formula?
qh: 'एम्पीयर के परिपथीय नियम' का समाकलन सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\oint B \cdot dl = \mu_0 I$ | $\oint B \cdot dl = \mu_0 I$
e: Relates line integral of magnetic field to enclosed current. / चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के रेखीय समाकलन को घिरे हुए करंट से जोड़ता है।

qe: Which material is used in 'Magnetic Bubbles' memory?
qh: 'मैग्नेटिक बबल' मेमोरी में किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Special magnetic films where tiny domains (bubbles) store data. / विशेष चुंबकीय फिल्में जहाँ छोटे डोमेन डेटा स्टोर करते हैं।

qe: What is 'Faraday's Disk' an example of?
qh: 'फैराडे की डिस्क' किसका उदाहरण है?
e: The first electromagnetic generator. / पहला विद्युत चुंबकीय जेनरेटर।

qe: What is 'Mutual Inductance' of two coils if current changes at 1 A/s and EMF is 5V?
qh: दो कुंडलियों का 'अन्योन्य प्रेरकत्व' क्या होगा यदि करंट 1 A/s से बदलता है और EMF 5V है?
e: $M = 5 / 1 = 5 H$. / गणना सूत्र के अनुसार।

qe: What is 'Tesla' in base SI units?
qh: मूल SI इकाइयों में 'टेस्ला' क्या है?
e: Derived from $F = qvB \implies B = F/qv$. / सूत्र $F/qv$ से व्युत्पन्न।

qe: Which 'Force' is used in an 'Electric Fan'?
qh: 'विद्युत पंखे' में किस 'बल' का उपयोग होता है?
o: Magnetic Force on current carrying coil | करंट ले जाने वाली कुंडली पर चुंबकीय बल
e: Magnetic field exerts torque on the motor windings. / चुंबकीय क्षेत्र मोटर वाइंडिंग पर बलाघूर्ण लगाता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of 'Antimony'?
qh: 'एंटीमनी' की 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' क्या है?
e: Antimony is a diamagnetic material. / एंटीमनी एक प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थ है।

qe: What is 'Step-up' transformer effect on 'Power'?
qh: 'स्टेप-अप' ट्रांसफार्मर का 'शक्ति' (Power) पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: Transformers only change voltage/current ratios, not total power. / ट्रांसफार्मर केवल वोल्टेज/करंट अनुपात बदलते हैं, कुल शक्ति नहीं।

qe: Which material is used for 'Recording Head' of hard disks?
qh: हार्ड डिस्क के 'रिकॉर्डिंग हेड' के लिए किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Permalloy has very high permeability for fast field switching. / तेज क्षेत्र स्विचिंग के लिए परमअलॉय की पारगम्यता बहुत उच्च होती है।

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Field' at a distance 'r' on the axis of a dipole?
qh: एक द्विध्रुव के अक्ष पर 'r' दूरी पर 'चुंबकीय क्षेत्र' किसके समानुपाती है?
e: Fields of dipoles fall off much faster than point charges. / द्विध्रुव के क्षेत्र बिंदु आवेशों की तुलना में बहुत तेजी से गिरते हैं।

qe: What is 'Phase' difference for 'Antinodes' in two adjacent loops?
qh: दो आसन्न लूपों में 'प्रस्पंदों' (Antinodes) के लिए 'कला' अंतर क्या है?
e: Adjacent loops in a standing wave vibrate in opposite directions. / स्थिर तरंग में पास के लूप विपरीत दिशाओं में कंपन करते हैं।

qe: What is 'Eddy Current' used for in 'Speedometers'?
qh: 'स्पीडोमीटर' में 'भंवर धारा' का उपयोग किसलिए होता है?
o: To rotate the pointer | सुई को घुमाने हेतु
e: Magnetic drag moves the needle against a spring. / चुंबकीय खिंचाव सुई को स्प्रिंग के विरुद्ध घुमाता है।

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a unit area called in CGS?
qh: CGS में इकाई क्षेत्रफल से गुजरने वाले 'फ्लक्स' को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Gauss is Maxwell per square centimeter. / गॉस मैक्सवेल प्रति वर्ग सेंटीमीटर है।

qe: Which part of Earth is the 'Source' of its magnetic field?
qh: पृथ्वी का कौन सा भाग उसके चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का 'स्रोत' है?
e: Liquid molten iron convection currents. / तरल पिघले लोहे की संवहन धाराएं।

qe: What is 'Curie's Constant' unit?
qh: 'क्यूरी नियतांक' की इकाई क्या है?
e: Derived from $\chi = C/T$. / सूत्र $\chi = C/T$ से व्युत्पन्न।

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of an 'Ideal Solenoid' with zero resistance?
qh: शून्य प्रतिरोध वाले 'आदर्श परिनालिका' का 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' क्या होगा?
e: Depends only on geometry and turns. / केवल ज्यामिति और फेरों पर निर्भर करता है।

qe: Which 'Force' causes the 'Spiral' path in magnetic fields?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों में 'कुंडलीनुमा' (Spiral) पथ किस 'बल' के कारण होता है?
o: Magnetic Lorentz Force | चुंबकीय लोरेंट्ज़ बल
e: Result of velocity having both parallel and perpendicular components. / समानांतर और लंबवत वेग घटकों का परिणाम।

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of 'Soft Iron' approx?
qh: 'नरम लोहे' की 'निग्राहिता' लगभग क्या है?
e: Easy to demagnetize, ideal for temporary magnets. / विचुंबकित करना आसान है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of 'Liquid Oxygen'?
qh: 'तरल ऑक्सीजन' की 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' क्या है?
e: Oxygen is a paramagnetic substance. / ऑक्सीजन एक अनुचुंबकीय पदार्थ है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Flux' through a closed spherical surface around a magnet?
qh: एक चुंबक के चारों ओर बंद गोलाकार सतह के माध्यम से 'चुंबकीय फ्लक्स' क्या है?
e: Because magnetic monopoles do not exist. / क्योंकि चुंबकीय एकल ध्रुव मौजूद नहीं हैं।

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loop' area for 'Transformer' core material ideally?
qh: 'ट्रांसफार्मर' कोर सामग्री के लिए 'हिस्टेरेसिस लूप' का क्षेत्रफल आदर्श रूप से क्या होना चाहिए?
e: To minimize energy loss as heat. / ऊष्मा के रूप में ऊर्जा हानि को कम करने के लिए।

qe: What is 'Self Induction' unit 'Henry' in terms of 'Weber/Ampere'?
qh: 'हेनरी' वेबर/एम्पीयर के संदर्भ में क्या है?
e: Standard definition of Inductance unit. / प्रेरकत्व इकाई की मानक परिभाषा।

qe: Which 'Substance' moves from 'Stronger' to 'Weaker' parts of a field?
qh: कौन सा 'पदार्थ' क्षेत्र के 'मजबूत' से 'कमजोर' हिस्सों की ओर बढ़ता है?
e: Diamagnets are repelled by the field. / प्रति-चुंबक क्षेत्र द्वारा प्रतिकर्षित होते हैं।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Induction' ($B$) related to 'Permeability' ($\mu$) and Intensity ($H$)?
qh: 'B', '$\mu$' और 'H' में क्या संबंध है?
e: Basic relation in magnetic media. / चुंबकीय माध्यम में बुनियादी संबंध।

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of 'Magnetic Dipole Moment'?
qh: 'चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण' की दिशा कौन सा 'नियम' देता है?
o: Right-hand Thumb Rule | दाएं हाथ के अंगूठे का नियम
e: Fingers curl with current, thumb gives moment direction. / उंगलियां करंट के साथ मुड़ती हैं, अंगूठा आघूर्ण की दिशा बताता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Declination' at the 'Magnetic Poles'?
qh: 'चुंबकीय ध्रुवों' पर 'चुंबकीय दिकपात' क्या होता है?
e: Because the magnetic horizontal component is zero at the poles. / क्योंकि ध्रुवों पर चुंबकीय क्षैतिज घटक शून्य होता है।

qe: What is the relation between 'Magnetic Susceptibility' ($\chi$) and Temperature ($T$) for Diamagnetic materials?
qh: प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थों के लिए 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' ($\chi$) और तापमान ($T$) के बीच क्या संबंध है?
e: Diamagnetism is a fundamental property of atoms and does not change with temperature. / प्रति-चुंबकत्व तापमान के साथ नहीं बदलता।

qe: Which property of a 'Galvanometer' allows the needle to stop quickly?
qh: 'गैल्वेनोमीटर' का कौन सा गुण सुई को जल्दी रुकने की अनुमति देता है?
e: Eddy currents produced in the metallic frame oppose the motion. / धात्विक फ्रेम में पैदा होने वाली भंवर धाराएं गति का विरोध करती हैं।

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of the product of Magnetic Flux and Resistance?
qh: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स और प्रतिरोध के गुणनफल की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Induced charge $\Delta q = \Delta \Phi / R$. So $\Phi = qR$. Unit is Coulomb-Ohm or Volt-second. / प्रेरित आवेश के सूत्र से।

qe: What is 'Maxwell’s Bridge' used to measure?
qh: 'मैक्सवेल ब्रिज' का उपयोग क्या मापने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: Specifically used for measuring self-inductance of a coil. / विशेष रूप से कुंडली के स्व-प्रेरकत्व को मापने हेतु।

qe: The 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of a material is 0.5. What type of material is it?
qh: एक पदार्थ की 'चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति' 0.5 है। यह किस प्रकार का पदार्थ है?
e: Small positive susceptibility indicates a paramagnetic substance. / छोटी धनात्मक प्रवृत्ति अनुचुंबकीय पदार्थ का संकेत है।

qe: What happens to the 'Self Inductance' of a solenoid if its radius is doubled?
qh: यदि एक परिनालिका की त्रिज्या दोगुनी कर दी जाए तो उसके 'स्व-प्रेरकत्व' का क्या होगा?
o: Four times | चार गुना हो जाएगा
e: $L \propto Area$, and $Area \propto radius^2$. So $2^2 = 4$. / क्षेत्रफल त्रिज्या के वर्ग के समानुपाती होता है।

qe: Which 'Law' states that 'The path integral of B around a closed loop is $\mu_0$ times the current'?
qh: कौन सा 'नियम' कहता है कि 'बंद लूप के चारों ओर B का रेखीय समाकलन करंट का $\mu_0$ गुना होता है'?
o: Ampere's Circuital Law | एम्पीयर का परिपथीय नियम
e: Fundamental law for calculating magnetic fields in symmetric cases. / सममित स्थितियों में चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की गणना का मौलिक नियम।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Intensity' (H) inside a hollow pipe carrying axial current?
qh: अक्षीय करंट ले जाने वाले खोखले पाइप के 'भीतर' 'चुंबकीय तीव्रता' (H) क्या होती है?
e: According to Ampere's law, enclosed current inside the hollow part is zero. / एम्पीयर के नियम के अनुसार, खोखले हिस्से के अंदर करंट शून्य है।

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a closed loop if the magnetic field is uniform and area vector is parallel to it?
qh: यदि चुंबकीय क्षेत्र एकसमान है और क्षेत्रफल सदिश इसके समानांतर है, तो बंद लूप के माध्यम से 'फ्लक्स' क्या है?
e: Angle $\theta = 0^\circ$, so $\Phi = BA \cos 0^\circ = BA$. / अधिकतम फ्लक्स।

qe: Which material is used in 'Magnetic Compass' needles?
qh: 'चुंबकीय कंपास' की सुइयों में किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: Steel is used because it retains magnetism (high coercivity) for a long time. / स्टील अपनी चुंबकीय शक्ति को लंबे समय तक बनाए रखता है।

qe: What is 'Isoclinic Line' on a map?
qh: मानचित्र पर 'आइसोक्लिनिक रेखा' क्या है?
o: Line of equal dip | समान नति (झुकाव) की रेखा
e: Connects places on Earth with the same magnetic inclination. / समान चुंबकीय झुकाव वाले स्थानों को जोड़ती है।

qe: The core of a 'Transformer' should have ______ hysteresis loss.
qh: 'ट्रांसफार्मर' के कोर में ______ हिस्टेरेसिस हानि होनी चाहिए।
e: To improve efficiency and reduce heating. / दक्षता बढ़ाने और तापन कम करने हेतु।

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of a material used for 'Electromagnets' ideally?
qh: 'विद्युत चुंबक' के लिए प्रयुक्त पदार्थ की 'निग्राहिता' आदर्श रूप से क्या होनी चाहिए?
e: So that it loses magnetism easily when current is switched off. / ताकि करंट बंद होते ही यह चुंबकत्व खो दे।

qe: Which part of Earth's magnetic field is 'Horizontal' at the poles?
qh: ध्रुवों पर पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का कौन सा भाग 'क्षैतिज' होता है?
e: At poles, the field is purely vertical, so the horizontal component is zero. / ध्रुवों पर क्षेत्र लंबवत होता है, इसलिए क्षैतिज घटक शून्य है।

qe: What is the 'Flux' linkage for a coil of 10 turns with 2 Weber flux per turn?
qh: 10 फेरों वाली कुंडली के लिए फ्लक्स लिंकेज क्या है, जिसमें प्रति फेरा 2 वेबर फ्लक्स है?
e: Flux linkage = $N \times \Phi = 10 \times 2 = 20$ Weber-turns. / कुल फ्लक्स लिंकेज।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Declination' at the geographic equator approx?
qh: भौगोलिक भूमध्य रेखा पर 'चुंबकीय दिकपात' लगभग क्या है?
o: Varies with longitude | देशांतर के साथ बदलता है
e: Declination depends on the specific location on Earth's surface. / दिकपात पृथ्वी की सतह पर विशिष्ट स्थान पर निर्भर करता है।

qe: Which 'Force' is used in 'Cyclotron' to keep particles in circular motion?
qh: कणों को वृत्ताकार गति में रखने के लिए 'साइक्लोट्रॉन' में किस 'बल' का उपयोग होता है?
e: Magnetic field provides the necessary centripetal force. / चुंबकीय क्षेत्र आवश्यक केंद्रोन्मुख बल प्रदान करता है।

qe: What is the unit of 'Magnetic Flux' in CGS system?
qh: CGS प्रणाली में 'चुंबकीय फ्लक्स' की इकाई क्या है?
e: $1 Weber = 10^8 Maxwell$. / मैक्सवेल छोटी इकाई है।

qe: What happens to the 'Permeability' of a Diamagnetic substance in a magnetic field?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थ की 'पारगम्यता' का क्या होता है?
e: They oppose the field, resulting in relative permeability less than 1. / वे क्षेत्र का विरोध करते हैं।

qe: What is 'Mutual Inductance' of two coils if EMF is 10V and rate of current change is 2 A/s?
qh: दो कुंडलियों का 'अन्योन्य प्रेरकत्व' क्या होगा यदि EMF 10V है और करंट परिवर्तन की दर 2 A/s है?
e: $M = 10 / 2 = 5 H$. / गणना सूत्र के अनुसार।

qe: Which rule gives the direction of 'Induced EMF' in a moving conductor?
qh: गतिमान चालक में 'प्रेरित EMF' की दिशा कौन सा नियम देता है?
o: Fleming's Right-hand rule | फ्लेमिंग के दाएं हाथ का नियम
e: Thumb=Motion, Forefinger=Field, Middle finger=Induced EMF. / अंगूठा गति की दिशा बताता है।

qe: What is 'Tesla' in terms of 'Weber' and 'Meter'?
qh: 'वेबर' और 'मीटर' के संदर्भ में 'टेस्ला' क्या है?
e: Tesla is flux per unit area. / टेस्ला प्रति इकाई क्षेत्रफल फ्लक्स है।

qe: Which 'Substance' has susceptibility $\chi < 0$?
qh: किस 'पदार्थ' की प्रवृत्ति $\chi < 0$ होती है?
e: Diamagnetic substances have small negative susceptibility. / प्रति-चुंबकीय पदार्थों की प्रवृत्ति ऋणात्मक होती है।

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of intensity of magnetization ($I$)?
qh: चुंबकन की तीव्रता (I) की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Magnetic moment per unit volume. / प्रति इकाई आयतन चुंबकीय आघूर्ण।

qe: What is 'Step-up Transformer' effect on 'Current'?
qh: 'स्टेप-अप ट्रांसफार्मर' का 'करंट' (Current) पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?
e: If voltage increases, current must decrease to conserve power. / वोल्टेज बढ़ने पर शक्ति संरक्षण हेतु करंट घटता है।

qe: Which material is used for 'Magnetic Shielding' of sensitive meters?
qh: संवेदनशील मीटरों के 'चुंबकीय परिरक्षण' के लिए किस सामग्री का उपयोग होता है?
e: High permeability alloy used to divert magnetic fields. / चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों को मोड़ने के लिए प्रयुक्त उच्च पारगम्यता वाली मिश्र धातु।

qe: What happens to the 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of a Ferromagnetic material when it is heated above its Curie temperature?
qh: Lauh-chumbakiya padarth ko Curie tapman se upar garam karne par uski 'chumbakiya pravritti' ka kya hota hai?
o: Follows Curie-Weiss Law (becomes paramagnetic) | Curie-Weiss niyam ka palan karti hai (anu-chumbakiya ho jati hai)
e: Above Curie point, the alignment is lost and it behaves like a paramagnetic material. / Curie bindu se upar, sanrekhan khatam ho jata hai aur ye anu-chumbakiya ki tarah vyavhar karta hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Intensity (H)?
qh: Chumbakiya teevrata (H) ki 'SI ikai' kya hai?
e: H represents the magnetizing force, distinct from B (induction). / H chumbakan bal ko darshata hai.

qe: Which component of 'Maxwell's Equations' states that there are no 'Magnetic Monopoles'?
qh: Maxwell ke samikaranon ka kaun sa bhag batata hai ki 'chumbakiya ekal dhruv' nahi hote?
o: Gauss's Law for Magnetism ($\nabla \cdot B = 0$) | Magnetism ke liye Gauss ka niyam
e: The divergence of the magnetic field is always zero. / Chumbakiya kshetra ka divergence hamesha shunya hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Lorentz Force' direction for an electron moving North in a field pointing Upwards?
qh: Ek electron jo Uttar ki aur ja raha hai aur kshetra Upar ki aur hai, us par 'Lorentz bal' ki disha kya hogi?
e: Using Fleming's Left Hand Rule and accounting for negative charge. / Fleming ke baayein hath ke niyam aur rinatmak avesh ko dhyan mein rakhte hue.

qe: What is the 'Work Done' by a magnetic field on a stationary charge?
qh: Ek sthir avesh par chumbakiya kshetra dwara kiya gaya 'karya' kya hota hai?
e: Magnetic fields only exert force on moving charges. / Chumbakiya kshetra sirf gatiman aveshon par bal lagate hain.

qe: Which material has a 'Permeability' less than that of free space ($\mu < \mu_0$)?
qh: Kis padarth ki 'pargamyata' mukt sthan se kam hoti hai?
e: Diamagnetic materials oppose the external field slightly. / Prati-chumbakiya padarth baahri kshetra ka thoda virodh karte hain.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Hysteresis' primarily caused by?
qh: 'Chumbakiya hysteresis' ka mukhya karan kya hai?
o: Molecular friction / Domain realignment delay | Domain sanrekhan mein deri
e: Internal friction between magnetic domains causes energy loss. / Chumbakiya domains ke beech ka aantrik gharshan oorja hani paida karta hai.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a coil of 200 turns if current of 2A produces 1 Wb flux linkage?
qh: 200 phero wali coil ka sw-prerakatva kya hai yadi 2A current 1 Wb flux linkage paida kare?
e: $L = \text{Total Flux Linkage} / \text{Current} = 1 / 2 = 0.5$ H. / Sw-prerakatva = kul flux linkage / current.

qe: What is the 'Effective Length' of a bar magnet compared to its 'Geometric Length'?
qh: Ek bar chumbak ki 'prabhavi lambai' uski 'jyamitiya lambai' ki tulna mein kya hoti hai?
e: Poles are slightly inside the ends of the magnet. / Dhruv chumbak ke kinaron se thoda andar hote hain.

qe: Which 'Law' is used to define the unit of magnetic flux 'Weber'?
qh: Chumbakiya flux ki ikai 'Weber' ko paribhashit karne ke liye kis 'niyam' ka upyog hota hai?
e: 1 Weber is the flux that induces 1 Volt in 1 second. / 1 Weber wo flux hai jo 1 second mein 1 Volt prerit karta hai.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' for a 'Perfect Diamagnet' like a Superconductor?
qh: Superconductor jaise 'purn prati-chumbak' ke liye 'chumbakiya pravritti' kya hai?
e: Perfectly cancels the internal magnetic field (Meissner Effect). / Aantrik chumbakiya kshetra ko puri tarah khatam kar deta hai.

qe: What is the 'Energy Density' of a magnetic field B in vacuum?
qh: Nirvat mein chumbakiya kshetra B ki 'oorja ghnatv' kya hai?
e: Energy stored per unit volume in the field. / Kshetra mein prati ikai aaytan sanchit oorja.

qe: What is 'Remanence' in a magnetic cycle?
qh: Chumbakiya chakra mein 'Remanence' kya hai?
o: Magnetism remaining at zero field | Shunya kshetra par bacha hua chumbaktva
e: Also called residual magnetism. / Ise avshesh chumbaktva bhi kehte hain.

qe: Which device uses 'Mutual Induction' to transfer energy between circuits?
qh: Circuit ke beech oorja sthanantaran ke liye kaun sa upkaran 'anyonya preran' ka upyog karta hai?
e: Transfers power via magnetic coupling. / Chumbakiya coupling ke madyam se power transfer karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Magnetic Dip' angle at the 'Magnetic Poles' of Earth?
qh: Prithvi ke 'chumbakiya dhruvon' par 'nati kon' kitna hota hai?
e: The field is strictly vertical at the poles. / Dhruvon par kshetra bilkul lumbvat hota hai.

qe: What is 'Tesla' in terms of 'Gauss'?
qh: 'Tesla' Gauss ke sandarbh mein kya hai?
e: 1 Tesla = 10,000 Gauss. / 1 Tesla = 10,000 Gauss.

qe: What is 'Step-up Transformer' effect on 'Secondary Current'?
qh: Step-up transformer ka 'secondary current' par kya prabhav padta hai?
e: To conserve power, current must drop as voltage rises. / Voltage badhne par current ghatna chahiye.

qe: Which material is used for 'Core' of permanent magnets?
qh: Sthayi chumbak ke 'Core' ke liye kis padarth ka upyog hota hai?
e: Requires high coercivity. / Uchh nigrahita ki zarurat hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of intensity of magnetization ($M$)?
qh: Chumbakan ki teevrata (M) ki 'SI ikai' kya hai?
e: Magnetic moment per unit volume. / Prati ikai aaytan chumbakiya aghurn.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Potential' at a point on the equatorial line of a magnet?
qh: Chumbak ki nirakshiya rekha par kisi bindu par 'chumbakiya vibhav' kya hai?
e: Potential from N and S poles cancel each other. / N aur S dhruvon se vibhav ek dusre ko khatam kar dete hain.

qe: Which rule gives the direction of 'Induced Current' in a generator?
qh: Generator mein 'prerit dhara' ki disha kaun sa niyam deta hai?
o: Fleming's Right-hand rule | Fleming ka daayein hath ka niyam
e: Used for generators (Left hand is for motors). / Generator ke liye upyog hota hai.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a long solenoid proportional to 'Number of turns' ($N$)?
qh: Ek lambi perinalika ka 'sw-prerakatva' phero ki sankhya (N) ke saath kaise badalta hai?
e: Inductance depends on the square of the turns. / Prerakatva phero ke varg par nirbhar karta hai.

qe: What is 'Agonic Line'?
qh: 'Agonic Line' kya hai?
e: Line joining places where magnetic north and true north coincide. / Shunya chumbakiya dikpat wale sthano ko jodne wali rekha.

qe: What is 'Relative Permeability' ($\mu_r$) of a paramagnetic material?
qh: Anu-chumbakiya padarth ki 'sapeksh pargamyata' ($\mu_r$) kya hoti hai?
e: Slightly greater than unity. / Ek se thodi adhik.

qe: What is 'Eddy Current' loss in transformer minimized by?
qh: Transformer mein 'Eddy current' nuksan kaise kam kiya jata hai?
o: Lamination of core | Core ka lamination
e: Using thin insulated sheets to break current loops. / Current loops ko todne ke liye patli insulated sheets ka upyog.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of 'Water'?
qh: 'Pani' ki chumbakiya pravritti kya hai?
e: Water is a diamagnetic substance. / Pani ek prati-chumbakiya padarth hai.

qe: What is the 'Flux' through a unit area called?
qh: Ikai kshetraphal se guzarne wala 'Flux' kya kehlata hai?
e: Also known as magnetic flux density. / Ise flux ghnatv bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a long solenoid proportional to?
qh: perinalika ka sw-prerakatva kiske samanupati hai?
e: Square of the number of turns. / phero ke varg ke samanupati.

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loop' area for steel compared to soft iron?
qh: steel ka hysteresis loop area narm lohe ki tulna mein kaisa hai?
e: Steel has higher energy loss. / steel mein oorja hani zyada hoti hai.

qe: Which 'Rule' gives the direction of magnetic field for a solenoid?
qh: perinalika ke liye chumbakiya kshetra ki disha kaun sa niyam deta hai?
o: Right-hand Palm rule | dayein hath ki hatheli ka niyam
e: Thumb = North pole. / angutha = uttar dhruv.

qe: What is 'Tesla' unit for?
qh: 'Tesla' kiski ikai hai?
e: SI unit of B.

qe: What is 'Self Inductance' of a straight wire?
qh: seedhe tar ka sw-prerakatva kya hai?
e: Requires a loop for flux linkage. / flux linkage ke liye loop chahiye.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Susceptibility' of 'Liquid Oxygen'?
qh: 'liquid oxygen' ki chumbakiya pravritti kya hai?
e: It is paramagnetic. / ye anu-chumbakiya hai.

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of soft iron?
