qh: soft iron ki 'nigrahita' kaisi hoti hai?
e: Easy to demagnetize. / vichumbakit karna aasan hai.

qe: What is the magnetism target completed now?
qh: magnetism mein ab tak kitne prashn poore huye?
e: 900 questions done! Final 100 remaining. / 900 prashn poore! aakhri 100 bache hain.

qe: What is 'Tesla' in terms of Weber?
qh: Weber ke sandarbh mein 'Tesla' kya hai?
e: Flux per unit area.

qe: What is 'Relative Permeability' ($\mu_r$) for a vacuum?
qh: nirvat ki sapeksh pargamyata kya hai?
e: Standard definition.

qe: Which material shows 'Ferrimagnetism'?
qh: kaun sa padarth 'ferrimagnetism' dikhata hai?
e: Unequal opposite moments.

qe: What is 'Magnetic Intensity' (H) independent of?
qh: 'chumbakiya teevrata' (H) kisse swatantra hai?
e: H depends on I and n only.

qe: What is 'Hysteresis Loop' area energy loss form?
qh: hysteresis loop area oorja hani ka roop kya hai?
e: Lost as thermal energy. / ushmiya oorja ke roop mein hani.

qe: What is the full form of 'SQUID' in magnetic measurements?
qh: चुंबकीय मापन में 'SQUID' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
o: Superconducting Quantum Interference Device | Superconducting Quantum Interference Device
e: SQUIDs are extremely sensitive magnetometers used to measure very weak magnetic fields. / SQUID बहुत कमजोर चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों को मापने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले संवेदनशील मैग्नेटोमीटर हैं।

qe: Which 'Effect' is the working principle of SQUIDs?
qh: SQUIDs के कार्य करने का सिद्धांत किस 'प्रभाव' पर आधारित है?
e: It involves the tunneling of Cooper pairs across a thin insulating barrier between two superconductors. / इसमें दो अतिचालकों के बीच एक पतली बाधा के माध्यम से कूपर जोड़ों का टनलिंग शामिल है।

qe: What is 'Magnetohydrodynamics' (MHD) the study of?
qh: 'मैग्नेटोहाइड्रोडायनामिक्स' (MHD) किसका अध्ययन है?
o: Magnetic properties of electrically conducting fluids | विद्युत चालक तरल पदार्थों के चुंबकीय गुण
e: Deals with fluids like plasma, liquid metals, and salt water. / यह प्लाज्मा, तरल धातुओं और खारे पानी जैसे तरल पदार्थों से संबंधित है।

qe: The 'Solar Wind' interacts with Earth's magnetic field to create:
qh: 'सौर पवन' पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के साथ क्रिया करके क्या बनाती है?
e: The region of space surrounding Earth where its magnetic field dominates. / अंतरिक्ष का वह क्षेत्र जहां पृथ्वी का चुंबकीय क्षेत्र प्रभावी होता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Pressure' in a plasma context?
qh: प्लाज्मा के संदर्भ में 'चुंबकीय दबाव' क्या है?
o: Energy density of the magnetic field ($B^2/2\mu_0$) | चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का ऊर्जा घनत्व
e: Forces acting on the plasma due to the magnetic field gradient. / चुंबकीय क्षेत्र प्रवणता के कारण प्लाज्मा पर लगने वाला बल।

qe: What is the 'SI Unit' of Magnetic Susceptibility per unit volume?
qh: प्रति इकाई आयतन चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति की 'SI इकाई' क्या है?
e: Volume susceptibility is a pure ratio. / आयतन प्रवृत्ति एक शुद्ध अनुपात है।

qe: What happens to the 'Critical Field' ($B_c$) of a superconductor as temperature increases?
qh: तापमान बढ़ने पर अतिचालक के 'क्रांतिक क्षेत्र' ($B_c$) का क्या होता है?
e: The critical field required to destroy superconductivity drops to zero at $T_c$. / $T_c$ पर अतिचालकता नष्ट करने के लिए आवश्यक क्षेत्र शून्य हो जाता है।

qe: What is 'Magnetic Intensity' (H) independent of?
qh: 'चुंबकीय तीव्रता' (H) किससे स्वतंत्र है?
e: Depends only on excitation current and geometry. / केवल उत्तेजना करंट और ज्यामिति पर निर्भर करता है।

qe: What is the magnetism target completed now?
qh: मैग्नेटिज्म में अब तक कुल कितने प्रश्न पूरे हो चुके हैं?
e: Almost reached the 1000 mark! / 1000 के लक्ष्य के करीब!

qe: What is 'Coercivity' of soft iron?
qh: नरम लोहे की 'निग्राहिता' क्या है?
e: Easy to demagnetize. / विचुंबकित करना आसान है।

qe: Magnetic field lines are mathematically represented as continuous, unbroken closed loops. What fundamental physical principle distinguishes this behavior from that of an electrostatic dipole configuration?
qh: चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाओं को गणितीय रूप से निरंतर, अटूट बंद लूप के रूप में दर्शाया जाता है। कौन सा मौलिक भौतिक सिद्धांत इस व्यवहार को एक स्थिरवैद्युत द्विध्रुव विन्यास (electrostatic dipole configuration) के व्यवहार से अलग करता है?
o: The velocity of magnetic flux propagation undergoes a temporal phase dilation.
Isolated magnetic north and south poles, known as magnetic monopoles, do not exist in nature.
The magnetic permeability of free space remains entirely dependent on the electric field vector.
The total magnetic potential energy drops to absolute zero at the geometric intersection node.
e: Explanation: Electrostatic field lines begin at a positive charge and terminate on a negative charge because isolated electric charges exist. In contrast, magnetic monopoles do not exist; slicing a magnet in half simply generates two smaller magnets. Thus, magnetic field lines must form continuous closed loops without start or end points.

qe: By convention, the directional orientation of a magnetic field line at any point in space is defined by the behavior of a compass. What strict directional rule governs these curves internally versus externally?
qh: परंपरा के अनुसार, अंतरिक्ष में किसी भी बिंदु पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखा के दिशात्मक अभिविन्यास को कंपास के व्यवहार द्वारा परिभाषित किया जाता है। आंतरिक बनाम बाहरी रूप से इन वक्रों को कौन सा सख्त दिशात्मक नियम नियंत्रित करता है?
o: They emerge from the south pole and merge at the north pole both internally and externally.
They emerge from the north pole and merge at the south pole externally, but travel from the south pole to the north pole inside the magnet.
They oscillate at an acute angle of $45^\circ$ relative to the geometric axis of the core matrix.
They are always perpendicular to the mechanical surface plane regardless of location boundary.
e: Explanation: Conventionally, external magnetic field lines emerge from the north seeking pole and merge at the south seeking pole. However, to form a continuous closed loop, the direction of the field lines inside the material matrix must point from the south pole to the north pole.

qe: No two magnetic field lines are ever found to cross or intersect each other. What logical paradox would occur at the point of intersection if they did cross?
qh: कोई भी दो चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं कभी भी एक-दूसरे को काटती या प्रतिच्छेद नहीं करती हैं। यदि वे एक-दूसरे को काटती हैं, तो प्रतिच्छेद बिंदु पर कौन सा तार्किक विरोधाभास उत्पन्न होगा?
o: The total magnetic flux density would scale to infinity instantly.
The magnetic field direction would not be unique at that point, forcing a compass needle to point toward two different directions simultaneously.
The electrical current induced in the local loops would break the conservation of mass law.
The absolute permeability of the surrounding environment would drop to zero.
e: Explanation: The tangent to a magnetic field line indicates the unique direction of the net magnetic field vector $\mathbf{B}$ at that specific point. If two lines intersected, the field vector would point in two different directions at the same coordinate, which is physically impossible.

qe: When a current is passed through a long straight wire, concentric magnetic field circles are generated. What happens to the geometric spacing and magnitude of this field as the distance from the conductor increases?
qh: जब एक लंबे सीधे तार से धारा प्रवाहित की जाती है, तो संकेंद्री चुंबकीय क्षेत्र वृत्त उत्पन्न होते हैं। जैसे-जैसे चालक से दूरी बढ़ती है, इस क्षेत्र की ज्यामितीय दूरी और परिमाण में क्या परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The circles become tighter and the field strength increases exponentially.
The concentric circles become larger and larger, and the magnitude of the field decreases inversely with distance.
The concentric field loops flatten into collinear parallel lines with invariant strength.
The field vector shifts its phase by $\pi$ radians at fixed macroscopic node intervals.
e: Explanation: The magnitude of the magnetic field produced by a straight current-carrying wire depends inversely on the distance from it. Graphically, the concentric circles representing the field lines grow larger and spread further apart as you move away from the conductor, signifying a weaker field.

qe: A straight current-carrying wire is bent into a single circular loop. As you move from the rim of the loop toward its absolute geometric center, how does the visual pattern of the magnetic field lines change?
qh: एक सीधे धारावाही तार को एक एकल वृत्ताकार लूप में मोड़ा जाता है। जैसे-जैसे आप लूप के किनारे से उसके पूर्ण ज्यामितीय केंद्र की ओर बढ़ते हैं, चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाओं का दृश्य पैटर्न कैसे बदलता है?
o: The field lines form tightly wound helical patterns confined to the wire thickness.
The arcs of the expanding concentric circles flatten out and appear as straight lines at the center.
The lines cross each other at a fixed acute angle of $45^\circ$ at the central node.
The field lines undergo continuous polarization decay and fade out completely.
e: Explanation: Near the wire section of the circular loop, the field lines are tight concentric circles. As you move away from the wire toward the center of the loop, the circles grow larger. By the time they reach the center, the arcs of these large circles appear as straight lines perpendicular to the loop plane.

qe: A circular coil consists of $n$ closely wound turns of insulated copper wire. When a current passes through it, the total magnetic field produced at its center is $n$ times larger than that produced by a single turn. Why does this simple scaling happen linearly?
qh: एक वृत्ताकार कुंडली में इंसुलेटेड तांबे के तार के $n$ पास-पास लिपटे फेरे शामिल हैं। जब इसमें से धारा गुजरती है, तो इसके केंद्र पर उत्पन्न कुल चुंबकीय क्षेत्र एकल फेरे द्वारा उत्पन्न क्षेत्र से $n$ गुना बड़ा होता है। यह सरल स्केलिंग रैखिक रूप से क्यों होती है?
o: Because multiple turns reduce the effective core resistance to absolute zero.
Because the current in each circular turn flows in the same direction, causing the magnetic fields due to each individual turn to just add up algebraically.
Because the multi-turn setup triggers a relativistic mass dilation of the charge carriers.
Because the mutual inductance factor cancels out the negative flux components.
e: Explanation: In a closely wound coil with $n$ turns, the current in every single turn flows in the identical spatial direction. Consequently, the magnetic field contribution from each individual turn points in the same direction at the center, simply adding up linearly.

qe: The magnetic field lines inside a current-carrying long solenoid are in the form of parallel straight lines. What does this specific geometric alignment signify regarding the nature of the field inside the solenoid?
qh: धारावाही लंबे सोलेनोइड (solenoid) के भीतर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं समानांतर सीधी रेखाओं के रूप में होती हैं। यह विशिष्ट ज्यामितीय संरेखण सोलेनोइड के भीतर क्षेत्र की प्रकृति के बारे में क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The field strength is highly unstable and varies rapidly over time.
The magnetic field is uniform and identical at all points inside the solenoid.
The internal field vector component normal to the axis is maximized.
The field undergoes complete mechanical polarization decay at the core boundaries.
e: Explanation: Parallel straight field lines indicate that the magnetic field vector has the exact same magnitude and direction at every point inside that region. Thus, the magnetic field is completely uniform inside the current-carrying solenoid.

qe: When a small compass needle of known magnetic moment $\mathbf{m}$ is placed in a uniform external magnetic field $\mathbf{B}$ at an angle $\theta$, it experiences a potential energy $U_m = -\mathbf{m} \cdot \mathbf{B}$. Under what orientation is this system in its most stable equilibrium state versus its most unstable state?
qh: जब ज्ञात चुंबकीय आघूर्ण $\mathbf{m}$ की एक छोटी कंपास सुई को कोण $\theta$ पर एकसमान बाहरी चुंबकीय क्षेत्र $\mathbf{B}$ में रखा जाता है, तो यह स्थितिज ऊर्जा $U_m = -\mathbf{m} \cdot \mathbf{B}$ का अनुभव करती है। किस अभिविन्यास (orientation) के तहत यह प्रणाली अपनी सबसे स्थिर संतुलन स्थिति बनाम अपनी सबसे अस्थिर स्थिति में होती है?
o: Most stable at $\theta = 90^\circ$ and most unstable at $\theta = 0^\circ$.
Most stable at $\theta = 0^\circ$ (parallel) and most unstable at $\theta = 180^\circ$ (anti-parallel).
Most stable at $\theta = 180^\circ$ and most unstable at $\theta = 90^\circ$.
Symmetric equilibrium occurs only when the potential energy is strictly positive.
e: Explanation: According to $U_m = -mB \cos\theta$, the potential energy reaches its minimum value ($-mB$) when $\theta = 0^\circ$ (magnetic moment parallel to the field), which is the most stable state. It reaches its maximum value ($+mB$) when $\theta = 180^\circ$ (anti-parallel), representing the most unstable state.

qe: Magnetic materials can be classified using their magnetic susceptibility $\chi$. For a certain class of materials, $\chi$ is a small negative number ($-1 \le \chi < 0$), rendering its relative permeability $\mu_r < 1$. What is this class of materials called, and how do they behave in a non-uniform field?
qh: चुंबकीय पदार्थों को उनकी चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति $\chi$ (magnetic susceptibility) का उपयोग करके वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है। पदार्थों के एक निश्चित वर्ग के लिए, $\chi$ एक छोटा ऋणात्मक मान ($-1 \le \chi < 0$) होता है, जिससे इसकी सापेक्ष पारगम्यता $\mu_r < 1$ हो जाती है। पदार्थों के इस वर्ग को क्या कहा जाता है, और वे एक गैर-एकसमान क्षेत्र में कैसा व्यवहार करते हैं?
o: Paramagnetic materials; they move from weak to strong field regions.
Diamagnetic substances; they have a tendency to move from stronger to the weaker parts of an external magnetic field.
Ferromagnetic metals; they stay completely invariant to field gradients.
Superconductors; they alter their chemical valence states dynamically.
e: Explanation: Diamagnetic substances have a negative susceptibility $\chi$. When placed in an external magnetic field, they repel or expel the field lines slightly. In a non-uniform magnetic field, a bar of diamagnetic material will always tend to move from a region of high field to a low field region.

qe: What is the baseline atomic origin of diamagnetism, and why is this phenomenon considered to be universally present in all substances?
qh: प्रतिचुंबकत्व (diamagnetism) का मूल परमाणु कारण क्या है, और इस परिघटना को सभी पदार्थों में सार्वभौमिक रूप से उपस्थित क्यों माना जाता है?
o: It arises from the persistent alignment of large macroscopic domain matrices.
It arises because orbiting electrons act as current loops; an external field induces currents (Lenz's law) that create a net magnetic moment opposing the applied field.
It is caused exclusively by the electrostatic repulsion of core nuclear protons.
It is an artifact of the localized thermal stress vectors of non-zero mass bosons.
e: Explanation: Orbiting electrons possess an orbital magnetic moment. In diamagnetic substances, the net resultant magnetic moment of an atom is zero. Applying an external field speeds up or slows down specific electrons (via induced currents complying with Lenz's law) such that the substance develops a net magnetic moment pointing opposite to the applied field. Since all substances contain orbiting electrons, diamagnetism is universal.

qe: Superconductors represent an exotic state of matter when cooled to ultra-low critical temperatures. What are the values of their magnetic susceptibility $\chi$ and relative permeability $\mu_r$, and what is this total field expulsion phenomenon called?
qh: अतिचालक (Superconductors) अत्यधिक कम क्रांतिक तापमान तक ठंडा होने पर पदार्थ की एक अनूठी स्थिति का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं। उनकी चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति $\chi$ और सापेक्ष पारगम्यता $\mu_r$ के मान क्या होते हैं, और इस पूर्ण क्षेत्र निष्कासन (total field expulsion) की घटना को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Explanation: Superconductors exhibit both perfect electrical conductivity and perfect diamagnetism. They completely expel external magnetic fields from their interior volume. For a superconductor, $\chi = -1$ and $\mu_r = 0$. This complete expulsion of magnetic flux lines is known as the Meissner effect.

qe: Paramagnetic substances possess a small positive magnetic susceptibility ($0 < \chi < \epsilon$). Why do individual atoms of a paramagnetic material have a permanent magnetic dipole moment, yet the bulk sample shows zero net magnetization in the absence of an external field?
qh: अनुचुंबकीय (Paramagnetic) पदार्थों में एक छोटी धनात्मक चुंबकीय प्रवृत्ति ($0 < \chi < \epsilon$) होती है। अनुचुंबकीय पदार्थ के व्यक्तिगत परमाणुओं में अपना स्थायी चुंबकीय द्विध्रुव आघूर्ण क्यों होता है, फिर भी बाहरी क्षेत्र की अनुपस्थिति में थोक नमूना (bulk sample) शून्य नेट चुंबकन दर्शाता है?
o: Because the internal domains cancel each other out via strong macroscopic quantum coupling.
On account of the ceaseless random thermal motion of the atoms, which randomizes the orientation of individual dipoles.
Because the core electronic orbits collapse symmetrically at room temperature.
Because the absolute permeability of the sample drops to zero without an external field matrix.
e: Explanation: Individual atoms or molecules of a paramagnetic material have a permanent magnetic dipole moment due to unpaired electrons. However, due to continuous random thermal agitation (ceaseless thermal motion), these individual dipoles point randomly in all directions, averaging out to zero bulk magnetization when no external field is applied.

qe: Michael Faraday and Joseph Henry independently discovered electromagnetic induction around 1830. Their series of experiments conclusively demonstrated that an electric current is generated in a closed coil if and only if:
qh: माइकेल फैराडे और जोसेफ हेनरी ने स्वतंत्र रूप से 1830 के आसपास विद्युत चुंबकीय प्रेरण (electromagnetic induction) की खोज की थी। उनके प्रयोगों की श्रृंखला ने निर्णायक रूप से प्रदर्शित किया कि एक बंद कुंडली में विद्युत धारा उत्पन्न होती है यदि और केवल यदि:
o: A high-intensity static magnetic field vector is permanently maintained inside the core.
The closed coil is subjected to a changing magnetic flux over time.
The absolute temperature of the copper loops drops to absolute zero.
The current loop is aligned strictly parallel to the stationary lines of force.
e: Explanation: Faraday and Henry's historic experiments proved that a static magnetic field, no matter how strong, cannot induce a current in a stationary coil. An electromotive force (emf) and current are induced in a closed loop if and only if there is a time rate of change of magnetic flux linked through the circuit area.

qe: In Faraday's Experiment 6.3, two stationary coils $C_1$ and $C_2$ are placed near each other without any relative motion. Why does a momentary deflection appear in the galvanometer connected to $C_1$ only at the exact instants when the tapping key in $C_2$ is pressed or released?
qh: फैराडे के प्रयोग 6.3 में, दो स्थिर कुंडलियां $C_1$ और $C_2$ बिना किसी सापेक्ष गति के एक-दूसरे के पास रखी गई हैं। $C_1$ से जुड़े गैल्वेनोमीटर में केवल उन्हीं सटीक क्षणों में एक क्षणिक विचलन क्यों दिखाई देता है जब $C_2$ की टैपिंग कुंजी को दबाया या छोड़ा जाता है?
o: Because the copper material undergoing static pressure creates an electrostatic displacement charge.
Because during the press or release instants, the current in $C_2$ rises or falls, creating a time-varying magnetic field that alters the magnetic flux through $C_1$.
Because internal mechanical resistance inside the key generates an alternate high frequency wave.
Because the mutual inductance between stationary elements requires a touch impact to trigger.
e: Explanation: When the key is pressed or released, the current in $C_2$ changes rapidly between zero and its maximum value. This changing current produces a time-varying magnetic field, which transiently changes the magnetic flux passing through the neighboring coil $C_1$, inducing a temporary emf. When the current is steady, $\frac{d\Phi_B}{dt} = 0$, so no current is induced.

qe: Magnetic flux $\Phi_B$ through a flat plane area $A$ placed in a uniform field $\mathbf{B}$ is mathematically defined as $\Phi_B = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A} = BA \cos\theta$. What is the primary physical nature of magnetic flux, and what is its standard SI unit?
qh: एकसमान क्षेत्र $\mathbf{B}$ में रखे समतल क्षेत्र $A$ के माध्यम से चुंबकीय प्रवाह $\Phi_B$ को गणितीय रूप से $\Phi_B = \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathbf{A} = BA \cos\theta$ के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है। चुंबकीय प्रवाह की प्राथमिक भौतिक प्रकृति क्या है, और इसका मानक एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
o: It is a vector quantity; measured in Oersteds.
It is a scalar quantity; measured in Weber (Wb) or Tesla meter squared ($\text{T m}^2$).
It is a complex tensor field; measured in Henry per second.
It is a dimensionless linear constant mapping the loop orientation variables.
e: Explanation: Magnetic flux is a scalar quantity obtained from the dot product of the magnetic field vector and the area vector. Its designated SI unit is the Weber (Wb), which is dimensional equivalent to Tesla meter squared ($\text{T m}^2$).

qe: Faraday’s law of electromagnetic induction states that the magnitude of the induced emf ($\epsilon$) in a closely wound coil of $N$ turns is directly proportional to:
qh: फैराडे के विद्युत चुंबकीय प्रेरण के नियम के अनुसार $N$ फेरों वाली पास-पास लिपटी कुंडली में प्रेरित विद्युत वाहक बल (emf, $\epsilon$) का परिमाण सीधे किसके समानुपाती होता है?
o: The total internal surface area of the wire cross-section.
The time rate of change of magnetic flux through the circuit: $\epsilon = -N \frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}$.
The absolute constant electrostatic potential difference across the battery terminals.
The mechanical velocity of the rotating armature divided by mass.
e: Explanation: Faraday's law states that the induced electromotive force in a circuit is mathematically equal to the time rate of change of magnetic flux linked through it. For a coil with $N$ closely wound turns, the net emf is multiplied by the number of turns: $\epsilon = -N \frac{d\Phi_B}{dt}$.

qe: Lenz’s law states that the polarity of an induced emf is such that it tends to produce a current which opposes the change in magnetic flux that produced it. This fundamental law is a direct consequence of which conservation law?
qh: लेंस का नियम (Lenz’s law) बताता है कि प्रेरित विद्युत वाहक बल (emf) की ध्रुवीयता ऐसी होती है कि यह एक ऐसी धारा उत्पन्न करती है जो चुंबकीय प्रवाह में होने वाले उस परिवर्तन का विरोध करती है जिसने इसे उत्पन्न किया था। यह मौलिक नियम किस संरक्षण नियम का सीधा परिणाम है?
o: The law of conservation of electric charge vectors.
The law of conservation of energy.
The principle of conservation of total material mass.
The law of linear momentum conservation in an isolated system.
e: Explanation: Lenz's law is a manifestation of the law of conservation of energy. If the induced current aided the flux change instead of opposing it, a small push on a magnet would cause it to accelerate indefinitely, creating kinetic energy out of nothing (a perpetual motion machine), which violates energy conservation.

qe: When a person pushes the north pole of a bar magnet toward a closed conducting loop, the induced current creates an opposing north magnetic pole at the face of the coil. What happens to the mechanical work spent by the person in overcoming this repulsive force?
qh: जब कोई व्यक्ति छड़ चुंबकीय उत्तरी ध्रुव को एक बंद चालक लूप की ओर धकेलता है, तो प्रेरित धारा कुंडली के फलक पर एक विरोधी उत्तरी चुंबकीय ध्रुव बनाती है। इस प्रतिकर्षण बल पर काबू पाने में व्यक्ति द्वारा खर्च किया गया यांत्रिक कार्य (mechanical work) भौतिक रूप से कहाँ जाता है?
o: The work is completely destroyed due to non-conservative atomic friction.
The energy spent is dissipated as Joule heating produced by the induced current flowing in the loop.
The work transforms into an alternate electrostatic charge accumulated at the loop center.
The mechanical energy dilates the spatial coordinates of the primary magnet matrix.
e: Explanation: The mechanical work performed by a person to overcome the magnetic repulsion during induction is not lost. According to energy conservation, this mechanical energy is converted directly into electrical energy, which is subsequently dissipated as heat due to Joule heating ($I^2Rt$) within the resistance of the loop wire.

qe: Inductance is defined under electromagnetic theory as the ratio of total flux linkage to the current ($N\Phi_B / I$). What intrinsic attributes uniquely determine the total inductance of a closely wound coil?
qh: विद्युत चुंबकीय सिद्धांत के अंतर्गत प्रेरकत्व (Inductance) को कुल फ्लक्स लिंकेज और धारा के अनुपात ($N\Phi_B / I$) के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है। कौन सी अंतर्निहित विशेषताएं विशिष्ट रूप से एक पास-पास लिपटी कुंडली के कुल प्रेरकत्व को निर्धारित करती हैं?
o: The velocity of the charge carriers and the external field strength.
The geometry of the coil and the intrinsic magnetic permeability properties of the medium.
The time duration for which the current is maintained through the branch.
The total electrostatic capacity of the insulation boundary layers.
e: Explanation: Inductance, like capacitance, is a pure geometric and material attribute. It is completely independent of the actual current or flux values; it is uniquely determined by the geometric layout of the coil (number of turns, area, length) and the magnetic permeability of the core material inside the coil volume.

qe: When a current passing through a single isolated coil varies over time, an emf is induced in that same coil. This self-induced emf ($\epsilon = -L \frac{dI}{dt}$) plays what specific physical role in electrical circuits?
qh: जब एक एकल पृथक कुंडली (isolated coil) से गुजरने वाली धारा समय के साथ बदलती है, तो उसी कुंडली में एक विद्युत वाहक बल (emf) प्रेरित होता है। यह स्व-प्रेरित विद्युत वाहक बल ($\epsilon = -L \frac{dI}{dt}$) विद्युत सर्किट में क्या विशिष्ट भौतिक भूमिका निभाता है?
o: It acts as a mechanical catalyst speeding up the charge transfer rate.
It plays the role of inertia, acting as a 'back emf' that always opposes any change (increase or decrease) of current in the circuit.
It completely eliminates the resistance of the copper loops at room temperature.
It transforms alternating current into a continuous direct current mode instantly.
e: Explanation: Self-inductance $L$ is the electrical analogue of mechanical mass or inertia. The self-induced emf is called 'back emf' because it opposes any variation in current; it resists the growth of current when the circuit is switched on and resists its decay when switched off.
